Apotheosis – Ascension to Godhood
Vol.2

Chapter 101
Luo Zheng faced the light emitted by the bonfire and raised his head to look. He saw dozens of female disciples standing on the broad branches of the spruce tree.
The female disciple in the lead held her long sword horizontally. Her expression was very nervous. She loudly shouted at Luo Zheng: "Don't go any further. Which mountain are you disciples from?"
Luo Zheng raised his head and replied: "We are Xiao Yufeng's disciples!"
In the entire Blue Cloud Sect, there was only one mountain peak with female disciples. These ten female disciples were definitely from Jade Maiden Peak.
Ever since Luo Yan appeared in Jade Maiden Peak, the strength of the entire mountain had increased by a lot. Although Luo Yan was currently trapped, Jade Maiden Peak's strength had always been hovering around the middle.
In any case, they were much stronger than Xiao Yufeng, who was ranked last.
Jade Maiden Peak was probably the most popular mountain peak among the 33 peaks of Blue Cloud Sect. This was because only Jade Maiden Peak had female disciples. If one wanted to find a partner, Jade Maiden Peak was the best choice.
The female disciple standing on the tree was called Zhu Qianning. As a descendant of the Spirit Needle Family Zhu and an inner disciple of Jade Maiden Peak, she was a core member of this Demon Slaying Trial.
"Xiao Yufeng? You guys stand there and don't use it! "Zhu Qianning warned again. She held a small jade box in her hand and faced Luo Zheng and the others.
Although Zhu Qianning was very surprised that the Torrential Pear Blossom Needles had no effect on Luo Zheng, as a descendant of the Family Zhu, she still had several powerful mechanisms in her hands.
For example, the small jade box in her hand was called "Frightening Dragon". Although it didn't look amazing, Zhu Qianning knew that once it was activated, the power it would release was almost equal to the full power attack of a Divine Realm expert!
Luo Zheng probably also felt the power contained in the small jade box and very obediently stopped his steps.
Soon after, Zhu Qianning handed the jade box to another female disciple of Jade Maiden Peak. She then jumped down from the tall tree.
Jumping down from a height of several zhang, her jet-black hair was a mess. Fortunately, her body was light and she steadily stepped on the ground in the forest. She used her hand to comb her hair before cautiously walking towards Luo Zheng.
Only when she got closer did Luo Zheng clearly see this girl's appearance. This girl's skin was whiter than snow. She was bright and beautiful with white teeth.. Although her figure was petite, it was extremely well-proportioned........... under the light of the bonfire, it added a hazy color.....
"Don't move!" Zhu Qianning raised her beautiful eyebrows and warned, "My Junior Sister's courage is even smaller than mine. If you move even a little bit and scare her, she will activate Frightening Dragon and all of you will die!"
Hearing the two words "Frightening Dragon", Lin Geng and Xiao Yufeng's faces suddenly changed. They were in the Blue Cloud Sect and were more familiar with the situation of the eight noble families than Luo Zheng. Naturally, they had heard of this powerful mechanism called "Frightening Dragon". This "Frightening Dragon" was said to be able to instantly kill all Xiantian lifeforms. Even Xiantian Stage Nine or Stage Ten would have no chance of survival after being hit by the "Frightening Dragon".
"Since you can carry Frightening Dragon with you, then you should be a member of the Divine Needle Family Zhu?" Lin Geng suddenly asked.
Who knew that after hearing Lin Geng's words, Zhu Qianning's face darkened. "I didn't ask you to speak. Don't speak!"
Looking at Zhu Qianning's appearance, Luo Zheng faintly smiled. Who knew that Zhu Qianning's face became even colder. "I didn't ask you to smile, so you can't smile!"
Therefore, Luo Zheng quickly withdrew his smile and stared at Zhu Qianning with a very innocent look.
Luo Zheng's artificial expression eased the tense atmosphere a lot. On the contrary, Zhu Qianning burst into laughter. Then, she waved her lily-white hand and a jade needle suddenly appeared.
She held the jade needle in her hand and waved it in front of Luo Zheng. Then, she carefully examined the color of the jade needle. Then, she walked towards Lin Geng and waved the jade needle in front of him. Xiao Yufeng had a total of eight people. She waved the jade needle in front of them one by one.
In the end, Zhu Qianning let out a sigh of relief. Her expression also relaxed a lot. She said to Luo Zheng and the others, "Okay, now I've ruled out the possibility that there are demon soldiers among you!"
Luo Zheng asked curiously, "You can tell by using this jade needle?"
Zhu Qianning faintly smiled. "This is our Family Zhu's Demon Breaking Needle. It's very sensitive to demon aura. If one of you was eaten by a demon and draped in human skin, no matter how hard you tried to hide it, you would still emit traces of demon aura. When this Demon Breaking Needle comes into contact with the demon aura, it will turn from green to red."
Luo Zheng nodded. Sure enough, each of the Eight Major Aristocratic Families had their own strengths. The Family Zhu was good at concealed weapons and all kinds of skills, so they could make such a clever thing.
Zhu Qianning immediately turned around and shouted, "Junior Sisters, you can come down. There are no demons among them."
Hearing Zhu Qianning's words, the female disciples of Jade Maiden Peak who were hiding in the trees jumped down and surrounded the bonfire.
Everyone gathered around the bonfire and sat down on the ground. Luo Zheng asked again, "You're all so cautious. Did you also encounter a demon attack before?"
When Luo Zheng asked this question, the expressions of the female disciples of Jade Maiden Peak dimmed. From the looks of it, they had already answered Luo Zheng's question.
Zhu Qianning nodded. Her eyes seemed to flicker with tears. "I originally thought that participating in the Demon Slaying Trials this time wouldn't be too dangerous. Moreover, we had Qi Fei, Senior Brother Long Yan and the others to protect us. Who would have thought …"
There were demon-slaying missions every year, and they were held every year.
The human race and the demon race could be considered as mortal enemies. Even though for so many years, due to the existence of the Burning Heaven Palace and the Blue Cloud Sect, the demon race had not taken even half a step into the Burning Heaven Empire.
However, in order to train the inner disciples, it was necessary to train them so that when fighting against the demon race, they would not be suppressed by the demon race and would be able to display their own strength.
The Demon Slaying Trials in Cang Qiong Forest required them to directly face the demon race. Their lives could be in danger at any time. It did sound very frightening.
However, in reality, there were very few cases of disciples dying in the Demon Slaying Trials every year. The reason was that in Cang Qiong Forest, only the demon race would appear to serve the disciples. And the so-called demon race serving the disciples were demon soldiers scouting the path.
The strength of the demon soldiers was not strong. At least, the inner disciples who were able to pass the selection and enter Cang Qiong Forest all had the strength to fight against them.
And this time, Jade Maiden Peak's participation in the mission was allied with the inner disciples of Black Rock Peak.
The so-called alliance was actually Black Rock Peak's willingness to protect the many female disciples of Jade Maiden Peak.
Black Rock Peak was ranked second among the Green Cloud Peak's thirty-three peaks. Even if the disciples participating in the Demon Slaying Trials were not the strongest disciples of Black Rock Peak, their strength was already very strong. For example, although Qi Fei and Long Yan were not on the Green Cloud Ranking, they were already quite famous in the Blue Cloud Sect. Their strength was evident.
However, when they were exploring Cang Qiong Forest, a demon general mixed in with them.
"You also had a demon general mixed in?" Luo Zheng frowned and asked.
Zhu Qianning nodded and said with a sorrowful face: "Yes, that demon general ate a disciple of Black Rock Peak and hid in his body. Later, under a sneak attack, he killed Qi Fei. Long Yan led a group of Black Rock Peak's disciples to fight and protect our Jade Maiden Peak's disciples to escape, but they … …"
Speaking up to here, several female disciples lowered their heads and tears faintly flickered in their eyes.
Facing a demon general, they were afraid that they would have already met with disaster.
This time, the strongest inner disciples participating in the Demon Slaying Trials were at Xiantian stage four or five. They were completely no match for a demon general.
Black Rock Peak was able to protect the Jade Maiden Peak's disciples to escape under such circumstances. They were indeed very brave!
At this moment, the atmosphere suddenly became silent. Everyone was lost in thought as they looked at the gently swaying flames.
"Don't worry, this time, I will protect you!" Luo Zheng suddenly smiled and broke the sad atmosphere.
When Luo Zheng said this, the female disciples of Jade Maiden Peak showed a strange expression and stared blankly at Luo Zheng.
If this sentence was said by Lin Geng of Xiao Yufeng, they would not find it strange.
However, Luo Zheng was a half-step Xiantian. His strength did not seem to be outstanding among Xiao Yufeng's disciples. Although they understood Luo Zheng's intention, they knew that he was just comforting them.
Lin Geng saw this and smiled bitterly, "We also encountered a demon general. In the end, we relied on Luo Zheng to kill him. If it were not for him, our Xiao Yufeng's disciples would have been wiped out."
When the female disciples heard Lin Geng's words, their faces showed an expression of disbelief.
Zhu Qianning's beautiful eyes looked at Luo Zheng and smiled. She shook her head and said: "I don't believe it!"
"Sister Qianning, I don't believe it either!" Another female disciple said.
Lin Geng still smiled bitterly. If he did not see it with his own eyes, he would also not believe it if someone told him that a half-step Xiantian martial artist killed a demon general with his own hands.
However, the truth was the truth. Even if the female disciples did not believe it, it was the truth.
Luo Zheng did not deny or admit it. The reason why he said this was to liven up the atmosphere.
As the saying goes, a defeated army is bound to be defeated. People should never lose their courage at any time. As Luo Zheng saw it, Zhu Qianning probably had more than one powerful hidden weapon for self-defense. If she did not have enough courage, she would have had a chance to fight the demon general.
The night was getting darker and darker. The dense spruce tree crown covered the faint moonlight. The entire Cang Qiong Forest fell into darkness. Except for a pile of fire, it was almost impossible to see the surrounding things.
Occasionally, a large demon beast would pass by not far away, making rustling sounds.
Zhu Qianning and the female disciples, after experiencing the encounter during the day, were now very sleepy. They leaned on each other and fell into a deep sleep.
Xiao Yufeng's disciples took turns to keep watch and take turns to rest.
This night, time seemed to pass very slowly. The sentries were always on tenterhooks, but those who were resting also could not sleep well. From time to time, some people would wake up from nightmares.
In this kind of torment, the sky finally brightened. This night, it was peaceful.
Luo Zheng did not sleep this night. His soul had stepped into a realm that ordinary people could not compare to. Even if he did not rest for several days and nights, Luo Zheng's spirit was still full.
He meditated the whole night, comprehending the second move of the 《Heavenly Devil God Fist》, 《Ten Thousand Demons Surge》.

Chapter 102
Although the sky had brightened, the crisis was still there.
If there were only demon soldiers in the Cang Qiong Forest, then the Blue Cloud Sect's disciples would use the forest as a hunting ground. The inner sect disciples could easily hunt down those weak demon soldiers.
But now that a Demon General had appeared in the Canopy Forest, all of the Blue Cloud Sect disciples were the Demon General's prey!
Yesterday, not only did Luo Zheng and the others encounter Demon Generals, but the disciples of Jade Maiden Peak also encountered Demon Generals. This showed that there were many Demon Generals in the entire Canopy Forest.
In the past, demon generals rarely appeared in the entire Cang Qiong Forest.
This time around, there were actually so many Demon Generals. What was the reason?
The disciples couldn't understand. After all, White Emperor City was like an impregnable fortress that stood firmly in front of the Asura battlefield. How could it have allowed these Demonic Generals to sneak in?
Could there be a problem with White Emperor City?
They were full of questions, but they couldn't get an answer. It became a stone that weighed down on the hearts of all the Blue Cloud Sect disciples.
After the rays of sunlight penetrated through the leaves and lit up the entire forest, the group extinguished the bonfire and continued their journey.
Although everyone was very worried, no one chose to give up. Moreover, even if they wanted to give up, they would have to turn back the way they came. Who could guarantee that they would not encounter the Demon Clan on the way back?
Xiao Yufeng and the disciples of Jade Maiden Peak continued to advance along the predetermined path.
Because of yesterday's lesson, everyone was much more cautious today. In order to prevent the Demon General from eating them, they put on human skin and hid in the group. Everyone moved in groups of four. At the same time, every hour, Zhu Qianning would wave the Demon Breaking Needle in front of everyone.
After walking like this for two hours, they suddenly heard a shout coming from the front.
Then, there was a series of explosions.
"There's a fight ahead!" Lin Geng's expression changed as he unsheathed his sword.
Many disciples held their weapons in their hands at the same time. At the same time, the men and women divided into two groups and walked forward quickly.
Sure enough, in the forest ahead, there were disciples of the Blue Cloud Sect engaged in a fierce battle with the Demon Clan. For a time, the Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan's Demonic Beast Clan
In that battle, the most dazzling person was a young man holding a pair of black and white swords.
In the man's hands, one was black and one was white. Two simple swords were incomparably sharp in his hands. Strands of true essence were attached to the two swords, turning into layers of sword light that shot out in all directions. Facing a Demon General head on, he was actually not at a disadvantage!
"Ah, that's Zhu Tianlai! It's Lone Sky Summit's Senior Brother Zhu! "Zhu Qianning said softly.
Luo Zheng discovered the young man from afar. This inner disciple named Zhu Tianlai was indeed quite strong. Relying on the strength of Xiantian fifth stage, he was actually able to confront a demon general head-on!
There was a reason why Lone Sky Peak was able to surpass the Blue Cloud Sect and become the leader of the thirty-three peaks.
Under normal circumstances, the Demon-Slaying Trial would not send the top inner disciples of their mountain peaks. However, Zhu Tianlai was actually able to deal with a Demon General alone.
But Lone Sky Peak's situation was not much better either.
Because Lone Sky Peak was facing two Demon Generals and dozens of Demon Soldiers.
Aside from Zhu Tianlai confronting a Demon General alone, there were three other inner disciples who were using all their strength to pin down another Demon General. However, those three inner disciples were barely able to face that Demon General. At this moment, they were already surrounded by danger. As long as that Demon General killed any one of the inner disciples, then the scales of victory and defeat would tilt.
"Let's go help!" After Lin Geng finished speaking, the treasured sword in his hand flickered with silver light as he pointed it at a Demon Soldier.
Jade Maiden Peak's disciples and Xiao Yufeng's disciples all rushed towards the surrounding Demon Soldiers.
If it was in the past, the disciples of each mountain peak would not interfere with each other in the Demon-Slaying Trial because the danger was not great.
But now that they were facing a crisis, everyone could only huddle together for warmth. Only in this way would they have a chance to survive.
Although Xiao Yufeng and Jade Maiden Peak's disciples had joined the battle, there was not much change to the battle situation because they did not dare to participate in the battle between Demon Generals.
The Demon General's strength was too terrifying. If one's own strength was insufficient and rashly participated, then one would be killed by the Demon General.
At this moment, only one person was charging towards the Demon General. That person was Luo Zheng.
The three inner disciples of Lone Sky Peak were all at Xiantian stage four.
These three people seemed to have come from the same origin. They formed a triangular formation, each standing on their own position, forming an exceptionally ingenious battle formation. Only then did they barely manage to block the Demon General's attack.
No matter how crazily the Demon General attacked, the three people were always able to find an ingenious angle to neutralize the Demon General's attack.
Theoretically speaking, if the three people cooperated closely, then they would be able to display three times their strength, which would be enough to contend against the Demon General.
However, the battle formation formed by the three people still had a flaw in the end.
Because it was impossible for the three of them to cooperate without any mistakes. As long as any one of the three people made the slightest mistake or took a wrong step, then the Demon General would certainly seize the opportunity to kill one of them. The other two people's lives would also be in danger.
After a series of nerve-wracking changes, a flaw finally appeared in the battle formation of the three people.
One of them was very nervous under the pressure of the Demon General's enormous Demon Aura, so he took a wrong step and pulled too far away from the other two people. By the time he realized it and wanted to save him, it was already too late.
The Demon General let out a loud roar, stretched out its yellowish-brown palm, and grabbed towards one of the three inner disciples.
That person already understood that there was a problem with the battle formation of the three people. Seeing the sharp claws close at hand, his face turned ashen. Other than closing his eyes and waiting for death, he seemed to have no other choice … …
Although everyone was doing their best to resist the Demon Soldier, the majority of people's attention was focused on this side. They all understood that these two Demon Generals were the key to the battle situation. At this moment, seeing the Lone Sky Peak's Iron Triangle Formation being broken by the Demon General, everyone's heart quickly sank.
It was over. The Lone Sky Peak's Iron Triangle Formation had been defeated. Zhu Tianlai had been dealt with by the two Demon Generals. It wouldn't be long before the remaining people … … would all die.
Many people were already calculating whether they should escape at this critical moment. If they could escape, then it would be better!
However, right at that moment, a figure rushed toward the Monstrous General at an extremely fast speed.
That person rushed to the front of the Demon General. His speed didn't decrease in the slightest, and he actually forcefully crashed into the Demon General!
If a human's body was said to be made of flesh and blood, then the Demon Clan's body would be made of steel!
Under such a violent collision, wasn't it equivalent to an egg hitting a rock? Was he seeking death?
Most people thought so.
Only Xiao Yufeng's Lin Geng, Hao Shige, and the rest understood how abnormal Luo Zheng's body was.
"Ah, Senior Zhu, look at that Luo Zheng. Does he not want to live anymore?" A female disciple from Jade Maiden Peak shouted.
When Zhu Qianning saw Luo Zheng charging over without any regard for his life, her expression was unusually complicated. Although she didn't believe that Luo Zheng could actually kill a Demon General with his Half-step to Xiantian strength, how much courage did he need to dare to charge towards a Demon General so bravely under such circumstances?
This young man was definitely a very brave person!
That Demon General had focused all its attention on the three people in front of it. Now that a person suddenly charged out from the side, it glanced at the person from the corner of its eyes. A hint of mockery flashed in those unique ugly eyes of the Demon Clan.
He wasn't even a Xiantian lifeform. Was this human brat courting death by charging at him like this?
Whether it was a Demon or a human, they all felt that Luo Zheng was courting death.
But when Luo Zheng's body, which was much shorter than the Demon Clan, collided with the Demon General's body, a strange scene occurred.
"Bang!"
A muffled sound was heard.
That Demon General's body, which was close to the height of three people, was forcefully sent flying by Luo Zheng. It broke a dozen spruce trees beside it before it came to a stop.

Chapter 103
The Demon Clan's emotional expression was different from that of humans.
But at this moment, the other Demon General who was fighting fiercely with Zhu Tianlai had obviously slowed down. His ugly eyes were staring at Luo Zheng, and his eyes were constantly shaking.
Shaking the eyes was the Demon Clan's way of expressing shock.
At this moment, it should be a good opportunity for Zhu Tianlai to attack.
But Zhu Tianlai, who was holding the black and white swords and attacking fiercely, actually let go of an opportunity to attack. He looked at Luo Zheng with the same shocked eyes.
If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he wouldn't have believed that a half-step Xiantian boy could knock a Demon General away with brute force.
Zhu Tianlai was also very anxious. Although he could rely on the black and white swords and his secret technique to ensure that he wouldn't be defeated by a Demon General, he was very clear about the strength of his three Junior Brothers from Tianyi Peak. Their battle formation couldn't hold on for long, and once the three of them were defeated, he wouldn't be able to resist the two Demon Generals.
It was just that Zhu Tianlai never expected that a half-step Xiantian warrior would appear halfway. Looking at that guy's clothes, he was actually wearing a white robe. Was he an outer disciple?
It was this white-robed man who, under the violent impact, had actually knocked the Demon General several feet away!
This sudden attack surprised Zhu Tianlai, but at the same time, he saw hope. The black and white swords in his hands attacked the Demon General even more fiercely.
Zhu Qianning gently covered her small mouth with her hand and stared blankly at Luo Zheng, who was in a cloud of dust.
At this moment, Luo Zheng's aura was completely different from before. The aura he exuded was abnormally confident and domineering, with a kind of spirit that said, "Who else but me can do it?"
Although she and Luo Zheng had only known each other for a short time, for some reason, that aura made her heart beat extremely fast!
At this moment, only Xiao Yufeng's disciples were slightly calm, because they had already seen Luo Zheng's brute force and his strange attack methods.
"Roar!"
After being hit by Luo Zheng's attack, the Demon General was sent flying several meters away. With a howl, it crawled up from the ground.
With a furious roar, a crazy demonic aura immediately spread out. Within the demonic aura, there was boundless anger. Anyone could feel that the Monster General was truly furious.
The Demon General also understood that Luo Zheng was special. However, the enraged Demon General was only thinking about how to tear Luo Zheng to shreds.
Through their last exchange, Luo Zheng had already understood the strength and weaknesses of the Demon Generals.
Compared to humans, Fey Soldiers' attacks were more simplistic. They mostly relied on pure strength and the collision of their bodies. It was the same for Fey Generals. However, Fey Generals could use the bone spikes in their bodies to launch a sudden attack. The toughness of the bone spikes was comparable to a spiritual weapon! Moreover, when it pierced out from the body, it would often catch people off guard.
In terms of pure physical strength, Luo Zheng was the least afraid!
Facing the enraged Demon General, Luo Zheng spread out his hands. The Heavenly Devil True Qi stored in his dantian slowly flowed along his meridians.
Luo Zheng clenched his fist and pushed it forward, pointing it directly at the Demon General who was madly charging over. His eyes were filled with calmness.
"Get out of the way!"
"Be careful of the Demon General's bone spikes!"
Someone warned.
Even though Luo Zheng's terrifying impact just now had knocked away the Demon General who was caught off guard.
However, many people still stubbornly believed that Luo Zheng's strength was not enough to deal with the Demon General.
Humans were used to comparing their strength to others.
For example, the person who warned Luo Zheng was already a Xiantian lifeform. However, thinking back to when he was a half-step Xiantian lifeform, he was afraid that he would not be able to last more than one round against this Demon General.
These people's warnings were also out of goodwill. Luo Zheng had no time to be distracted. He could only stare at the Demon General who was charging towards him without any distractions.
Four bone spikes had already protruded from the Demon General's shoulder. When Luo Zheng was still a few meters away, the four bone spikes rapidly pierced out from its body, ruthlessly stabbing towards Luo Zheng.
Luo Zheng lowered his body, retreated, dodged, turned around, and circled around to the side. His movements were coherent and smooth. He was already close to the Demon General's side, and his fist was aimed at the Demon General's ribs.
"Demon Moves the World!"
Luo Zheng's movements looked extremely nimble, but in fact, every movement and every detail had been carefully calculated by him. He strived to not make the slightest mistake.
Compared to the Demon General's huge body, Luo Zheng's fist was pitifully small.
However, just as Luo Zheng's fist was about to hit the Demon General's body, a huge purple-black fist shadow appeared and drilled into the Demon General's body at an extremely fast speed.
The speed at which that fist shadow appeared was extremely fast, and the speed at which it disappeared was similarly extremely fast. Almost no one noticed it.
Everyone only saw Luo Zheng's light fist, but they didn't know just how terrifying of a power this fist carried.
"Pu!"
A light muffled sound could be heard from that Demon General's body.
That Demon General suddenly backed up, his steps a bit staggering, swaying back and forth as if he was drunk.
When he saw this Demon General's current appearance, Luo Zheng was also greatly shocked.
Up until now, Luo Zheng had only used the Demonic God Fist against a single enemy, and that was precisely Purgatory Mountain's Wang Yanmiao.
However, that time, Luo Zheng's' Demon Moves the World 'was easily stopped by Wang Yanmiao, neutralized by Wang Yanmiao's lotus flowers one after another.
It was also precisely because of that fist that Luo Zheng was able to survive under Wang Yanmiao's tremendous pressure.
That was why Luo Zheng couldn't predict just how powerful this Demonic God Fist truly was.
The Fey General kept retreating in extreme pain. When he raised his hand, the brownish-yellow arm fell from his body. From the wound on the arm, purplish-black Yuan Qi constantly emitted. The flesh and blood in the arm had been completely devoured by the Heavenly Devil True Energy!
At the same time, within the Demon General's chest, waves of Demonic True Energy also surged. All of the flesh within this Demon General's body was already 'eaten' by the Demonic True Energy.
This Demon General's state of death was extremely miserable. Luo Zheng didn't expect this Demonic True Energy to be so tyrannical either. Only when all of the flesh was completely devoured, when that Demon General was completely eaten, did the purple-black Demonic True Energy gradually scatter between heaven and earth …
The Blue Cloud Sect disciples here were all martial artists, more than half of them Xiantian lifeforms, so they were naturally extremely familiar with true energy and true essence.
However, none of them had ever seen such tyrannical true energy. It was actually able to infiltrate another's body and devour their flesh and blood!
Although Luo Zheng understood that the Demonic True Energy seemed to have the property of 'devouring', this Demonic True Energy seemed to have only devoured the lotus formed by Wang Yanmiao's true energy, as well as the 'Purple Sandalwood True Energy' in Luo Zheng's dantian. He didn't expect that the Demonic True Energy could actually devour the flesh and blood of a Demon …
Therefore, when Luo Zheng saw that his attack had caused such terrifying damage, he was also extremely shocked.
Demons were different from saber insects.
Most blade insects didn't have intelligence. Even the leader of the blade insects was controlled by the Blade Insect Queen. If the Blade Insect Queen ordered them to die or commit suicide, those blade insects wouldn't resist at all.
However, even the lowest level of the Demon Race had their own consciousness and intelligence. Like humans, they could feel fear and dread.
The Demon General that was currently fighting with the Lone Sky Peak disciple, Zhu Tianlai, saw that his companion had died tragically, and that he was continuously entangled with this brat wielding black and white swords in front of him. After attacking for a long time without success, the Demon General began to have thoughts of retreating.
However, the situation was often like this.
In the beginning, the Blue Cloud Sect disciples were fearful. None of them dared to charge at the Demon General and throw their lives away. However, when they saw that Luo Zheng had killed a Demon General in such a short period of time, their morale was greatly boosted. They all surrounded the Demon General.
The Demon General feinted and forced Zhu Tianlai to retreat. Then, he immediately tried to escape.
"Whoosh!" A dazzling silver sword beam shot over. It was Lin Geng's attack. He wanted to block the Demon General's escape route.
However, how strong was the Demon General's body? It completely ignored Lin Geng's sword beam and allowed the silver light to cut its body. It only left a few shallow cuts on its skin. It didn't get in the way at all.
Apart from Lin Geng, the other inner sect disciples also took action. However, none of them could stop the Demon General from escaping.
At this moment, everyone felt their eardrums tremble. Immediately, a buzzing sound was heard. It was extremely uncomfortable in their ears.
Everyone looked towards the source of the strange sound and saw Zhu Qianning holding a jade box. That jade box was one of the Family Zhu's ultimate weapons: Frightening Dragon.
She had already activated "Frightening Dragon".
The moment "Frightening Dragon" was activated, a strong flow of energy was activated. The jade box in her hand began to glow and heat up. In the blink of an eye, a burning dragon-shaped vital essence rushed out of the jade box.
Only those in the Illuminating Spirit Realm could burn their True Yuan to obtain more power.
Luo Zheng looked at the giant dragon that was constantly burning with true essence, and couldn't help but sigh in his heart. The Zhu Family's level of concealed weapons was so high, they could really create a strike that was comparable to the full power of a Divine Reflection Stage powerhouse!
The power of "Frightening Dragon" was unparalleled. It could kill any Connate lifeform below the Divine Reflection Realm.
After the crazily flying dragon rushed out of the jade box, it rushed forward. Judging by its power, it seemed to want to turn everything that dared to block its path into dust.
Seeing this, the Demon General jumped in fright. It was one thing for a Half-step to Inborn fella to kill his Demon General comrade, but now, the Demon General had been killed.
However, the attack released by the little girl in front of it made it even more fearful!
The Demon General sighed inwardly. Was it just bad luck, or had humans improved to such a level? Why were these juniors so difficult to deal with?
In the nick of time, the Daemon General rolled on the ground in a sorry state to avoid the direct impact of the dragon. However, a portion of the dragon still managed to hit the Daemon General, severely injuring his left arm.
"This little girl seems to be using some kind of hidden weapon. Her strength isn't that high." Thinking of this, the Demon General got up from the ground and rushed towards Zhu Qianning.
"Unfortunately … Zhu Qianning isn't a Divine Reflection Realm master. With these thoughts in his mind, his footsteps were light as he dashed forward.
Unknowingly, they had passed through the Sky Vault Forest and entered the northernmost county of the Skyblaze Dynasty, Guanghan County.
Compared to the other counties in the Eastern Region, the counties in the north were relatively less prosperous.
Guanghan Prefecture was far inferior to Luo Zheng's hometown, Chongyang Prefecture, not to mention the Burning Heaven Imperial Capital.
However, after running for two days and two nights in the wilderness, Luo Zheng could be considered to have seen a trace of human life. With Luo Zheng's current strength, it wouldn't be difficult for him to run across half of the Skyblaze Dynasty's territory in one breath and return to the Blue Cloud Sect.
However, he didn't have any important responsibilities at the moment, so there was no need for him to do so. Therefore, after entering Guanghan County, Luo Zheng found a restaurant to rest first.
This restaurant called "Golden Moon Restaurant" was considered a luxurious place for ordinary people. Although it couldn't be compared to the Golden Breeze Drizzle Building, it was considered one of the most high-end places in Guanghan County.
After two days and two nights of running, Luo Zheng was covered in dust.
However, the waiter of the Golden Moon Restaurant was quite knowledgeable. He didn't reveal the slightest bit of displeasure because of Luo Zheng's attire. Instead, his attitude was very humble.
In the waiter's eyes, people like Luo Zheng could be considered "Jianghu people". Generally, Jianghu people were extremely extravagant. They heard that these people had a currency called square crystal. A square crystal was more than enough to buy ten Golden Moon Restaurants. Ordinary gold and silver were like dung in their eyes.
Although these rumors were hearsay, the situation was indeed true. Just like Luo Zheng, as long as he casually threw out a square crystal, it was enough to turn an ordinary person into a rich man.
After Luo Zheng sat down, a table of good food was soon brought to the table.
Since he was eating alone, there was no need to be polite. He lowered his head and ate heartily. Like a whirlwind sweeping away clouds, he swept the food on the table.
Probably because Luo Zheng's table manners were too unsightly, the people at the next table whispered to each other. Luo Zheng didn't care. He ate his own food and thought about where to find a fast horse to continue his journey after dinner.
It would be great if he could get a Flying Chariot in Guanghan County, but the possibility was too small. However, in such a large county, it was likely that he could buy a Flying Dragon Horse or a Lightning Chasing Foal. Although they couldn't be as fast as the Flying Chariot, it was faster and more labor-saving. He would ask the waiter about this information later.
While Luo Zheng was eating, a group of people stomped into the restaurant. This group of people made a big fuss and threw two fist-sized gold ingots on the table, making loud banging noises.
"Waiter, good wine and good food, just bring it up!" The leader of the group, a man, sat on a chair and shouted loudly.
When the waiter saw the large gold ingots, his eyes were wide open. He quickly came up and bowed to serve them.
Luo Zheng only looked at them a few times before continuing to eat. However, these people's voices were especially loud. When they spoke, the entire restaurant could hear them clearly.
"Second Brother, are we really not going back to Jade Dragon Valley?" One of the men asked.
"Go back to Jade Dragon Valley? You're not dreaming, are you? Do you know who those people are? Let me tell you, they are people from the seven noble families! If you offend any one of them, they can destroy our Bamboo Leaf Gang with a single finger! "The leader of the group said with a glare.
"Ai, it's a pity. Our Bamboo Leaf Gang has been entrenched in Jade Dragon Valley for so many years, but we were actually chased out. We can only move our nest. Just thinking about it makes me feel vexed!" The man next to him said indignantly.
The leader of the group said again, "So what if we move our nest? In their eyes, we can't even be considered local snakes. They are not strong dragons, but … … Heavenly Dragons!" The man seemed to be unable to find a more suitable metaphor and could only speak without thinking.
"Fortunately, those people are really generous. Afterwards, they rewarded us with a few square crystals. Our fierce lands can be considered settled! We have to find a brothel tonight to have some fun. "Another man took over the conversation and said.
When Luo Zheng heard Jade Dragon Valley, his eyebrows immediately raised.
Luo Zheng was no stranger to the three words' Jade Dragon Valley '. Some time ago, he just happened to see it on the interlayer pages of the 《Weapon Refining Sect Arts》. There were two names recorded on it, and they were Nine Yin Mountain and Jade Dragon Valley!
These two names were not famous, so Luo Zheng was too unfamiliar with them. Moreover, he was busy preparing for the Demon Slaying Trial mission and did not carefully investigate. Now that he heard Jade Dragon Valley, Luo Zheng naturally paid more attention to it.
Listening to the conversation between the men, these people should be from a gang called the "Bamboo Leaf Gang". They were probably not good people and had been entrenched in Jade Dragon Valley all year round. Jade Dragon Valley should be their mountain stronghold.
However, from their tone, it seemed that they were chased out by the seven noble families. Not only that, the seven noble families gave them a few square crystals and sent them away.
Hearing this, Luo Zheng faintly smiled. For 《Weapon Refining Canon》 to be sold at such a price, there must be a great secret inside. Since Luo Zheng had that page, he had no reason to miss out on this secret.
Therefore, after eating and drinking to his heart's content, Luo Zheng put down his bowl and chopsticks and walked towards the group of men.
"Friend, I want to ask you about something," Luo Zheng asked with a smile.
The leader of the men turned his head and asked with his bell-like eyes, "What is it?"
"The Jade Dragon Valley you're talking about, what kind of place is it?" Luo Zheng asked again.
The big man sneered. Their Bamboo Leaf Gang was a commoner in the city, but in the mountains, they were bandits. How could they be willing to talk to ordinary people? Moreover, Luo Zheng looked like an inexperienced youth, so the man waved his hand, "Go play on the side. What kind of place is Jade Dragon Valley? What does it have to do with you?"
Luo Zheng didn't get angry and continued to ask, "Is it Jade Dragon Valley of Nine Yin Mountain?" Luo Zheng remembered the name of the place. Jade Dragon Valley should be located in Nine Yin Mountain.
Who knew that the man's eyes would widen even more, "Didn't you hear what I said? Regardless of whether it's Eight Yin Mountain or Nine Yin Mountain, it's not something you should know. If you don't leave now, you won't be able to leave. Boy, don't say I didn't warn you! "
Just as the man's voice fell, Luo Zheng's eyes narrowed slightly and an astonishing aura suddenly rushed towards the men.
Although these men had some skills and had taken many lives, they were basically at the Skin Refining Realm and Flesh Refining Realm. They were the most basic martial artists. How could they withstand Luo Zheng's aura?
Under Luo Zheng's aura, the faces of the members of the Bamboo Leaf Gang at the table turned pale. Their teeth chattered incessantly, making ear-piercing sounds.
It wasn't until Luo Zheng withdrew his aura that the men's pale faces gradually recovered. However, at this moment, they were still deathly pale and there wasn't the slightest trace of blood on their faces. The Bamboo Leaf Gang finally understood that the person in front of them wasn't to be trifled with!
Luo Zheng lightly tapped his finger and took out a square crystal from his Sumeru Ring. He casually threw it on the table, "Speak, where is Jade Dragon Valley of Nine Yin Mountain?"
The man looked at the square crystal on the table and understood that he had to take it even if he didn't want to. He had to say the location of Jade Dragon Valley even if he didn't want to …
"Nine Yin Mountain … It's not big, it's just a small mountain. Go out of Guanghan County's North Gate and follow the official road for 20 li. Jade Dragon Valley is on the side of Nine Yin Mountain. Climb up Nine Yin Mountain and you'll see a bamboo forest. Go around the bamboo forest and you'll see a deep pool. Behind the deep pool is Jade Dragon Valley!" After all, this was the den of these men. Even in such a tense situation, the man spoke smoothly.
Luo Zheng patted the burly man's shoulder and said, "Very well, this square crystal is yours!"
After speaking, Luo Zheng paid for the meal and went downstairs. He had to make a trip to Jade Dragon Valley.
After Luo Zheng left, the man was paralyzed in his chair. He no longer had the heroic spirit from before. "How can these people be so abnormal!"

Chapter 133
According to the man's words, after leaving the northern gate of Guanghan County, he had to walk twenty li on the official road.
With Luo Zheng's speed, twenty li was nothing more than an instant.
After reaching the twenty li north of Guanghan County, Luo Zheng saw a small path that extended to a small mountain not far away. This mountain should be Nine Yin Mountain.
Just as the man had said, Nine Yin Mountain was only a small mountain and was not famous. This kind of mountain could be found everywhere, and not many people in Guanghan County knew about it.
After climbing to the top of the mountain, he saw a bamboo forest from the side. Following the bamboo forest, he heard the sound of flowing water. It was the sound of several small streams flowing down from the mountain and converging into a pool.
"After crossing this pool, it should be Jade Dragon Valley. I wonder what kind of secret is hidden in this Jade Dragon Valley!"
Luo Zheng followed the edge of the pool and went around it. Suddenly, he heard two shouts in front of him. "Who goes there!"
After the two shouts were heard, he heard two sounds of air being torn apart. Two flying axes were spinning at an extremely high speed and were flying towards his head.
Luo Zheng's face sank. The broken throwing knife jumped into his hand and shot out explosively. It drew an arc in the air and instantly cut the two flying axes in half!
Looking over, he saw two people holding flying axes, one on the left and one on the right. They continued to gesture at Luo Zheng, "We are from the Forbidden City's Yu Family. This is not a place you should be. Quickly retreat!"

"Then you are courting death!"
"I'll turn you into a human stick and plant you in the bamboo forest as a warning to others to prevent others from trespassing!"
These two men didn't give Luo Zheng any time to talk nonsense. They rushed towards Luo Zheng with flying axes in their hands. When they were about twenty feet away from Luo Zheng, they instantly threw out four flying axes, aiming at Luo Zheng's limbs. They really wanted to chop off Luo Zheng's limbs and turn him into a human stick!
Although the four axes were thrown at the same time, there was always a first come first serve.
Luo Zheng waved his right hand, and the Soaring Phoenix Crystal in his arm emitted energy. His arm moved at an extremely high speed, leaving behind afterimages!
He actually caught the spinning flying axe with his bare hands!
Not only that, but Luo Zheng also threw the hatchet back at the two men. In a very short period of time, Luo Zheng had caught four hatchet attacks and thrown four more hatchet attacks.
From afar, it looked as if these four flying axes were directly hit back by Luo Zheng. In fact, it was Luo Zheng who caught them one by one and then threw them back.
The Soaring Phoenix Crystal was indeed very useful!
For others, the Soaring Phoenix Crystal could only be embedded into weapons, but for Luo Zheng, it could be used directly on his body!
The two men from the Yu Family of the Forbidden City, who were guarding outside, were shocked when they saw Luo Zheng throw their flying axes back at them. These two brothers were hired guards of the Yu Family. They had been practicing flying axes for decades, so the flying axes they threw out were extremely fast and powerful. Even they didn't dare to catch their own flying axes, but this young boy in front of them easily caught them. What was going on?
Luo Zheng didn't give them a chance to think about this problem. When the flying axes were thrown out, Luo Zheng moved.
While he was moving, Luo Zheng extracted the energy from the Soaring Phoenix Crystal. Through his eight extraordinary meridians, the energy quickly spread throughout his body. Following that, Luo Zheng felt as if his body had become much lighter, as if he only had the weight of a leaf!
Propelled by his own strength, Luo Zheng's figure shot toward the two men like a ghost.
When the two men saw Luo Zheng catch the four flying axes with one hand, they stopped looking down on him and were extremely vigilant against Luo Zheng. When they saw Luo Zheng rushing toward them, his speed suddenly increased, and the two men simultaneously took out two axes from their backs and chopped at Luo Zheng's head.
How could Luo Zheng give them a chance to wave their axes?!
At the same time, Luo Zheng's throwing knife quickly bounced out, leaving a bloody line on one of the men's neck. At the same time, Luo Zheng's body turned, and the broken throwing knife followed Luo Zheng in a circle. The other man's neck happened to be in the circle where the throwing knife went. After the throwing knife swept past, it also left a bloody line!
In an instant, two of the Yu Family's guards were killed!
Luo Zheng put away the broken throwing knife, walked past the two guards' corpses, and continued to walk forward.
Just as the group of burly men had said, this Jade Dragon Valley should be their Bamboo Forest Gang's stronghold. There were all kinds of weapons and wine jars in the valley, and there were even a few wooden houses built to serve as shelters.
After wandering around the Jade Dragon Valley, Luo Zheng found nothing except for the two people at the entrance of the valley!

The moment he reached out, Luo Zheng found something strange. He found that the bamboo that was cut off was actually an illusion.

Luo Zheng immediately understood that there should be an illusory formation set up here. Presumably, cutting off the bamboo in the middle was the way to enter the illusory formation.
Although the members of the Bamboo Leaf Gang had occupied this place for many years, no one had tried to cut off the bamboo in the middle. Naturally, they couldn't find out the secret behind it.
Needless to say, the person who cut off the bamboo, opened the illusory formation, and opened the entrance must be someone from the seven noble families.

Just like when Luo Zheng first provoked Zhuge Hong, he ended up provoking a group of people from his Family Zhuge. It could be imagined that this Family Zhuge would always find trouble with him.
Therefore, wearing the mask was a simple way to avoid trouble.
After putting on the mask, Luo Zheng lifted his leg and followed the footprints into the bamboo forest in front of him.
Luo Zheng was no stranger to illusory formations. After entering the Blue Cloud Sect, Luo Zheng had experienced a lot of illusory formations on the Blood Red Mountain.

"Where the hell is this?"
In front of Luo Zheng was a vast forest. If he looked at it from afar, he wouldn't have noticed it. But when he looked closer, every tree in this forest was more than a hundred times bigger than what Luo Zheng had seen in his life!
Looking from afar, Luo Zheng thought it was a blade of grass. But when he looked closer, he found that this blade of grass was like a big tree. As for the real big tree … Luo Zheng stood under its roots. His body was like an ant standing on the thick roots of several hundred feet. Luo Zheng couldn't see the whole picture.
"Is this really an illusory formation?" At this moment, Luo Zheng had a trace of doubt in his heart. If it wasn't an illusory formation, then where was this place? Where could there be such a huge plant?
No matter where it was, this place was definitely not the Eastern Region.
What made Luo Zheng feel even more strange was that he found a huge pink barrier in the sky, covering a hundred miles in all directions. This barrier was probably tens of thousands of feet high and hundreds of miles long. In the end, what kind of almighty person could build such a huge barrier?
The edge of the pink barrier closest to Luo Zheng was behind the entrance.
Luo Zheng slowly approached the pink barrier. From this barrier came a wave of energy that made Luo Zheng's heart palpitate!
"The energy in the blood jade crystal is said to be able to break all barriers. I wonder if it has any effect on this pink barrier?" Luo Zheng's curiosity was aroused.
The traces of energy that escaped from this pink barrier made Luo Zheng feel incomparably dangerous. To be on the safe side, Luo Zheng kept a distance from this barrier. Then, he forced out the energy of the blood jade crystal from his arm and carefully spread it towards this pink barrier.
When the energy of the blood jade crystal came into contact with the pink barrier, a tiny bolt of lightning suddenly shot out from the pink barrier.
"Pata!"
That lightning bolt swallowed up the energy of the blood jade crystal in an instant.

Luo Zheng couldn't help but swallow his saliva. So far, no one had ever been able to give him such a big pressure.
What's more, this pink barrier was just an inanimate object. Moreover, the entire barrier had spread so much, yet it could still maintain such power. Could it be that this was a barrier set up by the legendary immortals?
Luo Zheng originally wanted to try his Heavenly Devil Qi, but now he decided to give up. This barrier didn't seem to take the initiative to attack people. If he really attracted the lightning bolt, he was afraid that he would be miserable.
Just as Luo Zheng was about to leave the edge of the barrier, a creature suddenly appeared from outside the barrier.
It was a tiger, a white tiger!
If it was an ordinary tiger, even if there were thousands or tens of thousands of them, Luo Zheng wouldn't be afraid. However, this white tiger was different.
This tiger was actually hundreds of feet tall. In comparison, Luo Zheng's small body was even smaller than an ant in front of this tiger.

Chapter 135
Yan Jiu's sharp laughter came from within the smoke. His voice was like that of a foxy woman's. "Ah ha ha ha! It's been a long time since someone dared to say such words to me. In fact, Li Qiong's price was too low. The Chasing Lightning Colt was a precious horse of the Eastern Domain. Two square crystals was already an extremely cheap price.

Luo Zheng nodded, then turned his head and climbed onto the Lightning Chasing Foal. With a squeeze of his legs, he turned the horse around and gave Li Qiong a deep look before swaggering off. However, when he thought about the love of all parents in the world, he, Luo Zheng, was not such a narrow-minded person. Therefore, he held back his words.

Why did you cheat him of two square crystals! He gave us four square crystals, as if he was giving us a great bargain. How could he do business like this … "

Chapter 154
Strictly speaking, the Chasing Lightning Foal was no longer a horse. It could be considered a spiritual beast. This kind of spiritual beast had been tamed by some experienced and powerful people.

As a disciple of the Blue Cloud Sect, Luo Zheng naturally only followed the rules of the Blue Cloud Sect. As for the rules of this Disciplinary Hall, what kind of things were they?
This middle-aged man was precisely the Disciplinary Hall's vice hall master, his name Qin Mu. During these years, even if there weren't a thousand, there were still eight hundred disciples who had been interrogated by him. However, he had never seen a thorn that dared speak to him like this.

Ever since he participated in the Monster Slaying Trial, Luo Zheng never returned to the Blue Cloud Sect again. Hearing the three words Zhuge Ye, Luo Zheng suddenly understood.
Sigh, Luo Zheng couldn't help but sigh in his heart. These people really didn't have any scruples. Even if they wanted to take his life, they could have just casually made up a crime, which would be much better than this. However, they just had to accuse him of colluding with the Demon Clan …
The Burning Sky Dynasty and the Demon Clan had fought against each other for thousands of years. Colluding with the Demon Clan was a very big taboo for humans. This was a serious crime that could lead to the extermination of an entire clan!
However, Luo Zheng's face didn't show the slightest hint of panic. The guy in front of him obviously didn't know anything, but he still made up such a strange crime to punish him. Obviously, he was instructed by someone else. Luo Zheng guessed that the most likely culprit was someone from the Family Zhuge. It was very likely that it was Zhuge Feng who was called the Crazy Three.
Thinking of this, Luo Zheng smiled slightly, "You said that I colluded with the Demon Clan. I want to know, how do you want to deal with me?"
Qin Mu said coldly, "This kind of serious crime is a disaster that can lead to the extermination of an entire clan. However, I've already investigated and found that no one from the Luo Clan was involved. You can just obediently accept your punishment!"
Luo Zheng suddenly took two steps forward, stared at Qin Mu, and said with a smile, "My life is right here. Whoever wants to take it away will have to rely on their ability. If you have the ability, then come and take it. Don't use these rules and regulations to find excuses, because you're not qualified!"
A small Disciplinary Hall wanted to convict Luo Zheng with just a few words? Too naive!
Therefore, Luo Zheng simply made their purpose clear. If they wanted to fight, then let's fight. It was too boring to beat around the bush and pin a crime on him! Luo Zheng also didn't have time to dawdle with them.
Qin Mu's face became very ugly. He sneered a few times, and suddenly said to Luo Zheng, "In that case, come! Give me the Heaven's Ultimate Rod, I want to beat you to death! "
As soon as Qin Mu's voice fell, four people walked out from the Disciplinary Hall. They held four dazzling long rods in their hands. This Heaven's Ultimate Rod was made from a type of strange wood, as hard as metal. More importantly, this type of strange wood could easily penetrate true essence.
Even if one used true essence to protect the body, this Heaven's Ultimate Rod could still easily penetrate true essence and strike the flesh. Even if it was a Xiantian expert, they would still be beaten to death!
In fact, right now, Qin Mu also felt a bit guilty. His Disciplinary Hall didn't have the qualifications to take someone's life. According to the Blue Cloud Sect's rules, unless a disciple committed a great crime of betraying the sect, they could be directly executed. However, this still had to be approved by the higher ups of the Blue Cloud Sect. Other crimes were normally banished to Purgatory Mountain.
However, since he was entrusted by someone, his goal was precisely to take Luo Zheng's life!
If the Disciplinary Hall wanted to take someone's life, they also had a flexible method. They couldn't kill you, but they could beat you to death. This was also a flexible method.
If Luo Zheng resisted, then the Disciplinary Hall could even kill him. If he didn't resist, then he would really be beaten to death by rod after rod!
At this moment, Luo Zheng had already made preparations for battle. No matter who it was, if they wanted to take his life, they would have to pay a terrible price. Even if it was a colossus like the Blue Cloud Sect, it was no exception!

He, Luo Zheng, wasn't afraid of being beaten the least …
Now that he had broken through to the Xiantian realm, he was worried that no one would beat him!
Since this was the case, Luo Zheng also temporarily gave up on resisting. He would take this rod first and think about other things later.
