Chapter 161
Luo Zheng glanced at Zhenren Tianqiong and his Family Zhuge members, then continued to ask Reverend Zi Qing: "Reverend, if someone wanted to kill you right now, what would you do?"
Hearing Luo Zheng's question, Reverend Zi Qing said without hesitation: "If the opponent wanted to kill me without distinguishing between right and wrong, I would fight back."
Luo Zheng nodded again: "Reverend Zhuge is right. If someone wanted to kill you, no one would be willing to be a lamb waiting to be slaughtered. Then, Reverend Zhuge Feng, do you know where the heavy sword I used to kill Zhuge Feng that day came from?"
"I don't know." Reverend Zi Qing shook his head. He wasn't present that day, so of course he wouldn't know what happened yesterday.
Even Zhenren Tianqiong had only just arrived, so he didn't see what happened at the scene clearly. In the Admonition Hall, only Luo Zheng and Qin Mu knew what happened that day.
"Then I'll tell you, Reverend. The heavy sword I used to kill Zhuge Feng that day was borrowed from Zhuge Feng's Zhenyuan Giant Sword! The reason I took his Zhenyuan Giant Sword was because Zhuge Feng wanted to kill me with it. So, why didn't I just stand there and let him kill me? "Luo Zheng asked rhetorically.
Reverend Zi Qing's face flashed with a trace of doubt. "What you said seems to make sense, but I don't understand the part about the Zhenyuan Giant Sword."
"Reverend Zi Qing, Zhuge Feng used our Family Zhuge's Heaven class technique, the 'Seven Mysterious Demonic Sword'. It can transform Zhenyuan into a giant sword to fight the enemy. That Zhenyuan Giant Sword was transformed from Zhuge Feng's Zhenyuan, but this brat said that he took away Zhuge Feng's Giant Sword. He's full of nonsense. Who can take away someone's Zhenyuan Avatar?" Zhuge Yingge couldn't help but step forward and say.
"Snatch someone else's True Yuan Clone?" Reverend Zi Qing shook his head after hearing this.
Indeed, none of the Perfected Ones present had ever heard of any technique in this world that could snatch away another's True Essence Avatar.
Seeing the blank expression on Reverend Zi Qing's face, Luo Zheng pursed his lips. He thought that the ten Reverends of the Blue Cloud Sect were only so-so. It must be known that Luo Zheng's 《Heavenly Demon God Fist》 came from the Blue Cloud Sect's Heavenly Book Pavilion, but none of these Reverends knew about it.
"Kid, you're still spouting nonsense at a time like this. Immortal Zi Qing, I don't think there's any need to interrogate him. He clearly committed a violent crime and should be sentenced to death!" Zhenren Tianqiong said coldly.
However, Luo Zheng said unhurriedly, "Since Zhenren Tianqiong doesn't believe me, why don't you let me demonstrate it? Facts speak louder than words!"
Zhenren Tianqiong saw that Luo Zheng was speaking so confidently and had some doubts in his heart. However, he still didn't believe that Luo Zheng could swallow someone else's True Yuan.
He, Daoist Heaven Vault, had never heard of or seen such a cultivation technique before.
In fact, all the Perfected Ones present had heard of the 《Heavenly Demon God Fist》. When the only copy of the 《Heavenly Demon God Fist》 was stored in the Heavenly Book Pavilion, most of them were present.
However, although the 《Heavenly Demon God Fist》 was rated as a saint-level technique, no one had succeeded in cultivating it until now.
Naturally, they had never seen the 《Heavenly Demon God Fist》 or the true effect of the Heavenly Demon Vital Qi.
In fact, the fact that Luo Zheng could use his own True Yuan to swallow someone else's True Yuan had caused an uproar in White Emperor City. More than one or two people knew about this.
However, this matter happened in the Imperial Army and did not spread from White Emperor City.
"Well, in that case, I'd like to see how you can take away someone else's True Yuan!" After saying that, Zhenren Tianqiong said to Qin Mu, who was next to him, "Qin Mu, release your True Yuan Incarnation and see if this guy can do it!"
Qin Mu was anxious. Zhenren Tianqiong wasn't present that day and didn't see the scene of Luo Zheng swallowing True Yuan. However, Qin Mu saw it clearly.
That day, Zhuge Feng had released seven True Yuan swords, which had been swallowed by Luo Zheng. In the end, the seven swords had been combined into one giant sword and forcibly withstood Zhenren Tianqiong's palm strike. Why didn't Zhenren Tianqiong understand?
Unfortunately, Qin Mu didn't have the chance to quietly remind Zhenren Tianqiong. He could only brace himself, take out the Judge Pen, summon the True Yuan in his body, and write a character in the air. Then, he sent the character condensed by the True Yuan in Luo Zheng's direction.
Luo Zheng looked at the character formed by the True Yuan and slowly floated over. He raised his arm and a strand of Heavenly Demon Vital Qi shot out from his finger.
The strand of Heavenly Demon Vital Qi instantly entered the character written by Qin Mu. Before long, all the True Yuan in the character was swallowed by the Heavenly Demon Vital Qi.
After that, Luo Zheng waved his hand, and the words written by Qin Mu began to obediently revolve around him and dance in the air.
When the Perfected Masters saw this, their expressions changed dramatically.
"This kid is actually telling the truth. He can really swallow True Yuan!"
"What cultivation technique is he cultivating? No matter what the outcome of this trial is, we have to find out! "
Only a true powerhouse would understand what it meant to be able to swallow other people's True Yuan.
Luo Zheng had also used this technique to resolve countless dangerous situations and even fight against Divine Reflection Realm powerhouses!
Zhenren Tianqiong's expression was extremely ugly. He had some doubts before, especially when his Family Zhuge had mentioned the Seven Mysterious Demonic Sword. He recalled that day when Luo Zheng had controlled a giant sword to kill Zhuge Feng.
However, Zhenren Tianqiong had thought that it was Luo Zheng's cultivation technique.
Who would have thought that Luo Zheng could actually control other people's True Yuan and use it for his own?
"As I said, facts speak louder than words. Great Perfected Master, what else do you have to say?" Luo Zheng said to Zhenren Tianqiong with a smile. Then, he clapped his hands and the character formed by True Yuan gradually dissipated into the air.
Zhenren Tianqiong's face darkened and he sneered, "Even if you can prove that you can swallow other people's True Yuan, so what? Can this erase the fact that you killed someone? "
Luo Zheng shook his head and said, "I've already said that Zhuge Feng killed me first. Should I have just stood there and let him kill me?"
Zhenren Tianqiong sneered, "It's just a one-sided story. Qin Mu, tell us what happened that day!"
Other than Qin Mu and his subordinates, there was only the woman by Zhuge Feng's side, Concubine Zhuo, who was present that day.
Luo Zheng killed Zhuge Feng. Concubine Zhuo couldn't wait for Luo Zheng to die quickly. Naturally, she wouldn't come forward to testify for Luo Zheng.
Zhenren Tianqiong asked Qin Mu to come forward at this moment. His purpose was obvious.
Qin Mu smiled and stood in front of the hall. He waved his hand at Perfected Zi Qing and then recounted what happened that day.
His narration was naturally different from Luo Zheng's. "That day, not only did Luo Zheng speak rudely in front of the Admonition Hall, but he also wanted to injure me! When I shouted for help, Zhuge Feng happened to pass by. Young Master Zhuge Feng acted bravely for a just cause and wanted to help me restrain Luo Zheng! But … Alas, "Qin Mu sighed and said," I didn't expect that Luo Zheng would be so cold-blooded and bloodthirsty. He killed Zhuge Feng without saying anything. I wanted to stop him, but it was too late … "
Qin Mu was obviously well-prepared. He recounted the events of that day in a methodical manner, describing Luo Zheng as a cold-blooded demon.
After he finished speaking, Qin Mu narrowed his eyes and smiled eerily at Luo Zheng. Then he took a few steps back and returned to his seat.
The other Perfected Masters walked to Perfected Zi Qing's side. Perfected Zi Qing waved his hand and a purple True Yuan suddenly formed a thick light screen, enveloping the six Perfected Masters inside.
The Perfected Masters began to discuss spiritedly within the light screen.
As for what they were saying, because of the light screen, the people outside couldn't hear a single word clearly.
This discussion didn't last for long. After about the time it takes for a stick of incense to burn, Perfected Zi Qing waved his hand and removed the light screen.
The Perfected Masters returned to their seats. Perfected Zi Qing stabilized the purple crown on his head and said solemnly, "Today, the Admonition Hall has been opened. It has been ascertained that Luo Zheng, a disciple of the Blue Cloud Sect, committed murder for no reason in the Admonition Hall, causing the death of Zhuge Feng, a disciple of the Blue Cloud Sect. Luo Zheng is a violent and sadistic person who massacred the innocent. He shouldn't be allowed to live in this world … "
Looking at Perfected Zi Qing's serious face, Luo Zheng suddenly laughed wildly in the Admonition Hall!
"Hahahahaha …"
Luo Zheng's laughter shook the heavens, completely overshadowing Perfected Zi Qing's words.
This brat was too arrogant. He actually dared to be so impudent. A smile appeared on the faces of Zhenren Tianqiong and the Family Zhuge. Could it be that Luo Zheng had gone crazy?
Perfected Zi Qing's face darkened. He suddenly shouted angrily, "Shut up!"
The roar contained Daoist Ziqing's Quintessential Essence. With the strength of a Daoist Ziqing, the roar that was mixed with the Quintessential Essence was extremely powerful.
A purple sound wave crashed toward Luo Zheng with the force of toppling mountains and overturning seas.
Luo Zheng, who was hit by the sound wave, stopped laughing abruptly. Traces of blood flowed out from the corners of his mouth. Obviously, he had suffered a serious internal injury.
Luo Zheng lightly covered his chest. He continued to sneer a few times and said slowly, "The Blue Cloud Sect is so famous. I didn't expect you Perfected Masters to deal with things like this! I, Luo Zheng, am ashamed of my inferiority. I'm not as thick-skinned as you guys. You're all sanctimonious, but you're actually distorting the truth … "
"If you speak rudely again, I'll kill you on the spot!" When had Perfected Zi Qing ever been lectured by a junior like this? This time, he was furious to the extreme.
"Haha? What's the difference between killing me now and killing me later? Do you think threats are meaningful? " The Heavenly Devil True Qi in Luo Zheng's body suddenly flowed out, forming a dark purple barrier around his body.
If death was inevitable, Luo Zheng would never allow himself to be captured without putting up a fight!
"Good. In that case, I'll fulfill your wish!" Perfected Zi Qing slammed the table. The True Yuan in his body suddenly surged.
The strength of a Perfected Master was unfathomable. If he wanted to kill Luo Zheng with all his strength, perhaps Luo Zheng wouldn't be able to escape.
"Kill him. Kill this arrogant brat!"
"This kind of scum, every day he stays in this world, he'll bring more harm to the world!"
The people of the Family Zhuge also clamored, especially Zhuge Yingge. At this moment, he also wanted to make a move. However, he thought that since Perfected Zi Qing had already made a move, there was no need for him to help. Luo Zheng must die today!

Chapter 162
Soon after, a beautiful figure leisurely walked in from the entrance of the Admonition Hall. It was Luo Zheng's mentor, Su Lingyun.
Compared to a few days ago, Su Lingyun's aura was extremely vigorous. Her entire body was bathed in a special aura.
Even though Su Lingyun's strength was far inferior to these Enlightened Masters in front of her, her aura was able to firmly suppress the aura emitted by these Enlightened Masters.
This kind of aura was the aura of someone who could unify the world and look down on all living things!
Only a true direct descendant of the imperial family could emit this kind of aura.
After being exposed by Zhenren Tianqiong, Su Lingyun went into seclusion for two days. Thousands of thoughts ran through her mind. Only at the last moment of her visit to Xun Ming Mountain did she realize that there were many things that she couldn't escape from.
Perhaps, she should pick up the things that she had thrown away.
Perhaps, they had all forgotten who she was!
She was the eldest daughter of the current emperor! She was the Princess of the Vast Sky who was doted on by thousands of people and worshipped by foreign countries!
Under Su Lingyun's aura, these Enlightened Masters even felt that they were much smaller.
"I'll ask again. Why am I not present today? The trial is also about to begin. Who was the one who made the decision? Zi Qing? " Su Lingyun's delicate eyebrows furrowed. She directly called Enlightened Master Zi Qing by his name. She even had an overbearing tone.
Even with Enlightened Master Zi Qing's strength and status, under Su Lingyun's interrogation, he actually felt suffocated. He immediately said, "Today's trial was set to begin at noon. Since you arrived at noon, we six Enlightened Masters couldn't wait any longer!"
"Is that so? That's fine. I won't pursue this matter any further. However, I want to ask you, what's the result of the trial? "Su Lingyun waved her hand. From behind her, six people bent their bodies and moved over a chair.
The chair was nine chi tall. It was inlaid with all kinds of jade, agate, and emerald. It was extremely exquisite.
The entire chair was made of Golden-Threaded Jade Glory Wood, which was an extremely rare type of wood.
Generally, it was used to make the hilts of spirit weapons, such as spear shafts.
Following the mining in recent years, the number of Golden Silk Jade Flourishing Wood had become fewer and fewer. For this reason, the Burning Sky Emperor Dynasty had issued an announcement that anyone who collected this wood was not allowed to keep it for themselves and had to hand it over.
If anyone gathered it for their own use, they would be severely punished!
Because it was too rare, generally speaking, only the core of a long spear at the level of a spirit tool would use this Golden Silk Jade Glory Wood.
From this, it could be seen how precious this Golden Silk Jade Wood was.
However, this Golden Jadewood was used to make a chair.
The entire body of this huge chair was made of Golden Silk Jade Flourishing Wood. If it was used to forge spear and saber handles for spirit weapons, who knows how many of them could be forged!
This chair was extremely heavy. Even with six burly men carrying it together, it was still very strenuous. However, the six of them bent their backs and took small, quick steps. Without saying a word, they placed the chair in front of the hall. Then, without saying a word, they took small, quick steps and left quickly.
Su Lingyun turned around and stepped on the small steps inlaid with gemstones and emeralds in front of the chair. She climbed to the top of the chair and turned around to sit down. She placed her pair of jade legs on the foot rest at the side. Her expression was slightly heavy and a languid expression appeared on her face. "Zi Qing, tell me. What is the result of the trial?"
In the face of Su Lingyun's actions, everyone immediately understood that today's matter would be difficult to resolve peacefully. At this moment, they could only fight for what was right.
Reverend Zi Qing said, "This brat violated the rules of our Blue Cloud Sect. He killed Zhuge Feng, the third son of the Family Zhuge's direct line of descent. Naturally, we will punish him according to the sect rules. A life for a life is right and proper."
Su Lingyun nodded. "Reverend Zi Qing is extremely right. A life for a life is right and proper. These words are indeed true. If Zhuge Feng wanted to kill Luo Zheng, and Luo Zheng was forced to kill him out of helplessness, would this life still need to be paid?"
"Of course not," Reverend Zi Qing continued. "However, when we opened the court for interrogation, it was already clear that it was Luo Zheng who spoke rudely and caused a ruckus in the admonition hall that day. This forced Zhuge Feng's assistant to help. He wanted to cooperate with Qin Mu to take Luo Zheng down. Unexpectedly, Luo Zheng …"
Before Reverend Zi Qing could finish speaking, Su Lingyun interrupted him. "I want to know, did Luo Zheng himself admit to your words? Or did he tell you this himself? "
"This was what Qin Mu told me. As for what Luo Zheng said, it was a completely opposite fact," Reverend Zi Qing replied.
"Alright then. Let me ask you. Why did you believe Qin Mu's words and not Luo Zheng's?" Su Lingyun suddenly changed her indolent appearance. Her bright eyes stared intently at Reverend Zi Qing. Her tone was even more aggressive and unyielding.
"This … this …" Su Lingyun's words caused Reverend Zi Qing to be momentarily at a loss for words.
"You guys just thought that the one who died was a descendant of a Zhuge Family, a descendant of a landowning household, and Luo Zheng was nothing more than a commoner. If Luo Zheng had been killed by Zhuge Feng that day, I don't think you guys would have cared about this matter at all!" Su Lingyun's tone became more and more dignified. Her eyes exuded the aura of an emperor. This aura was inherited from her father, the king of the entire Eastern Region!
Reverend Zi Qing couldn't say anything, but Zhenren Tianqiong said, "Your Highness, you're wrong. After all, Qin Mu is the Hall Master of the Admonition Hall. He's a fair and upright person. In comparison, it's naturally easier for us to believe his words. I think if Your Highness were the judge of this case, you'd also believe Qin Mu's words and not the murderer's one-sided story!"
Zhenren Tianqiong's words were more intelligent.
He probably meant to exonerate Reverend Zi Qing. This Luo Zheng was the murderer. In comparison, Qin Mu's words were much more trustworthy. They couldn't possibly believe Luo Zheng's words over Qin Mu's.
Su Lingyun's beautiful eyes sized up Zhenren Tianqiong, which immediately made Zhenren Tianqiong feel uncomfortable. Su Lingyun then said, "If that's the case, why don't you guys wait for me to come before starting the trial? I have evidence in my hands that proves that Luo Zheng is telling the truth. "
"You have evidence in your hands?" Reverend Zi Qing was stunned. Obviously, he didn't believe her.
Zhenren Tianqiong chuckled and said, "Your Highness must be joking. When Luo Zheng killed that day, I was also there. If you have evidence, how come I don't know about it?"
"Of course you don't know about it. Why would I let you know about my evidence? Let me ask you, if I didn't have evidence, why would I apply for a trial? "Su Lingyun asked rhetorically from her high chair.
After she finished speaking, Su Lingyun lightly clapped her hands.
Outside the Admonition Hall, the six large men once again rushed in.
This time, the six large men didn't carry chairs on their backs. Instead, they carried a letter jade tablet.
The six large men neatly placed the letter jade tablet next to Su Lingyun before retreating.
Immediately, Su Lingyun extended her slender fingers. A faint stream of true essence gushed out from her fingers and flashed into the surface of the letter jade tablet.
Not long after, an image appeared on the letter jade tablet.
At this moment, when all the Reverends saw the image on the letter jade tablet, their expressions immediately became very unsightly.
No one would've thought that Su Lingyun would be able to bring out a letter jade tablet at this time. Moreover, the letter jade tablet even recorded the scene of that day!
Even Luo Zheng himself was shocked. That letter jade tablet actually recorded the scene that happened in the Admonition Hall that day.
Luo Zheng also couldn't understand why Instructor Su would use a letter jade tablet to record the scene of that day!
Although he couldn't understand, Luo Zheng also understood that once this image was released, these old fellows would probably really be at their wit's end.
On the letter jade tablet, scene after scene was released. Those scenes were like clean and crisp slaps that violently slapped the cheeks of these Reverends.
This was true. Facts spoke louder than words.
"Reverends, is there anything else you want to say?" Su Lingyun stretched her pair of jade legs on the spacious chair. It was as if her sharp aura had been completely withdrawn. Her face once again changed into a languid expression.
"This …" At this moment, Reverend Zi Qing was completely speechless. At the same time, he looked at Zhenren Tianqiong beside him. In his heart, he was even complaining about Zhenren Tianqiong.
This Zhenren Tianqiong had said it in all seriousness. According to this judgment, there was absolutely no problem. As for Su Lingyun's side, there was no need to explain anything at all.
Actually, when the Reverends made this decision, they indeed didn't take Su Lingyun into consideration.
However, they didn't expect that Su Lingyun would make such a sharp counterattack at the most crucial moment.
They had indeed forgotten that Her Highness the Princess, who was once like the pearl of the empire, possessed such status and courage!
It was only later that Su Lingyun became very depressed because of those things in the palace. That was why she came to the Blue Cloud Sect to seek a position as an instructor, retracting her former sharpness.
However, Su Lingyun was still Su Lingyun. Even if she was at odds with the Burning Sky Palace, she was still the Eldest Princess of the Burning Sky Dynasty. No one could forget this fact!
"Reverend Zi Qing, don't you think that you should give me an explanation?" Seeing that the Reverends didn't speak, Su Lingyun could only set her target on today's main judge, Reverend Zi Qing.
Although Reverend Zi Qing was incomparably resentful of Zhenren Tianqiong in his heart, it was obviously unrealistic to expect Zhenren Tianqiong to stand out and take a blow for him at this moment. At this moment, he could only lower his head and say, "Your Highness the Princess, during today's trial, I, Zi Qing, have indeed neglected something. Your Highness the Princess, please forgive me."
"I can forgive you, but I don't know if Luo Zheng will forgive you. If I didn't appear today, I'm afraid that he would have already died in this Admonition Hall. You'd better go and ask Luo Zheng. "Su Lingyun said coldly.
Su Lingyun's intention was to force Reverend Zi Qing to apologize to Luo Zheng!
Asking a dignified Reverend to apologize to an outer disciple of the Blue Cloud Sect was somewhat unimaginable.

Chapter 163
Actually, there was no need for Su Lingyun to be so ruthless. At least today, she had successfully reversed the situation and rescued Luo Zheng unscathed.
However, Su Lingyun wanted the world to understand that she didn't show her power because she didn't want to. If anyone really provoked her, they would definitely be hurt by her sharp edge.
"Your Highness, isn't your request a bit too much …" Zhenren Tianqiong had no choice but to stand up at this moment. After all, he was the one who initiated the whole thing. Relatively speaking, Reverend Zi Qing was helping him take the blame.
"Is my request too much?" Su Lingyun shook her head. "Actually, it's not too much at all. Your judgment almost cost Luo Zheng his life. What's the big deal about apologizing? As the ancients say, nothing is better than knowing one's mistakes and being able to correct them. This isn't a very difficult thing to do! "
"Although that's true, this matter also depends on one's identity. We …" Zhenren Tianqiong continued.
However, Su Lingyun quickly interrupted him. "Tianqiong, Luo Zheng is the disciple I've chosen. You can watch carefully. In the future, his achievements and his identity will be something that even you can only look up to! Whether this identity is suitable or not, you don't need to tell me! "
Let a group of Reverends look up to her!
It wasn't that easy to be a Reverend of the Blue Cloud Sect. These ten Reverends had all made great contributions to the Blue Cloud Sect. It took them hundreds of years to reach their current status.
Any one of these Reverends was an existence that people looked up to in the Eastern Region.
However, Su Lingyun said with certainty that Luo Zheng's future achievements would far surpass these Reverends. These words were undoubtedly too full of themselves.
However, who would dare to casually refute Her Highness the Princess' words?
"Yes, I did apologize today! It's only right that I apologize to Luo Zheng! "After Reverend Zi Qing finished speaking, he stepped down from the front of the hall and respectfully bowed to Luo Zheng!
Seeing this scene, the expressions of the other Adepts were extremely ugly. It was as if water could be squeezed out from their cloudy faces.
Although they weren't the ones apologizing, but Reverend Zi Qing, they were all part of the top ten Reverends of the Blue Cloud Sect. Reverend Zi Qing's apology was equivalent to disrespecting all the other Reverends!
After Reverend Zi Qing bowed, he didn't say a word and walked out of the Admonition Hall.
When the other Sages saw this, they all left one after another.
As for Zhuge Yingge's Family Zhuge people, they just stared at Luo Zheng with gloomy eyes and left through the side door. Today, Su Lingyun was here, so it was almost impossible to touch Luo Zheng. Staying here was just asking for humiliation.
For a moment, only Luo Zheng and Su Lingyun were left in the Admonition Hall.
Luo Zheng turned his head and looked up at Su Lingyun, who was sitting on the throne, with a faint smile. He walked up to Su Lingyun and cupped his hands with a smile: "This humble one greets Her Highness the Princess!"
Su Lingyun jumped down from her chair and extended her hand to knock Luo Zheng's head: "You still dare to smile mischievously with me. I let you participate in the Demon-Slaying Trial, but you came back alone. You just came back, and trouble immediately came looking for you. Tell me how troublesome you are!"
Because of the Demon Clan's invasion, the disciples of the Blue Cloud Sect had all returned to the Blue Cloud Sect on the large flying chariot. However, Luo Zheng was the only one who was forced to stay in White Emperor City because of Yun Luo's imprisonment.
After that, because he passed by Guanghan Prefecture and found clues to the Immortal Mansion, Luo Zheng was delayed for a period of time. Therefore, he returned to the Blue Cloud Sect much later than the other disciples.
"Instructor Su, there is one thing I don't understand," Luo Zheng suddenly said, "Why is there an image of the day before yesterday in the letter tablet?"
It was actually a coincidence that Su Lingyun was able to record everything that happened that day.
After Luo Zheng participated in the Demon-Slaying Trials, he had not returned. Although Su Lingyun heard from Lin Geng and the others that Luo Zheng was fine and had only been detained by a strong martial artist from the Emperor's army, Su Lingyun knew that Luo Zheng had not returned.
According to Lin Geng's description, Su Lingyun guessed that the person was Yun Luo.
As such, Su Lingyun could only slowly wait in the Blue Cloud Sect.
In the end, as time passed day after day, Luo Zheng still didn't return. Su Lingyun began to feel a bit of worry, to the extent where she even wanted to send someone to White Emperor City to investigate.
However, the day before yesterday, Su Lingyun accidentally opened the letter tablet, discovering that she could track Luo Zheng!
Su Lingyun had previously done something to Luo Zheng's disciple tablet, just like last time when Luo Zheng headed to Purgatory Mountain alone, Su Lingyun used the letter tablet to monitor him …
Luo Zheng wore a disciple tablet, so as long as he entered the Blue Cloud Sect, her letter tablet would be able to track him.
That was why back then, Su Lingyun's letter tablet already recorded everything that happened the day before yesterday. When she discovered that Luo Zheng was threatened by Zhenren Tianqiong through the letter tablet, only then did Su Lingyun contact Flame Dragon Daoist, hurrying towards Xunming Mountain together.
As for why Luo Zheng asked her why the letter tablet would have images of the day before yesterday, Su Lingyun only pursed her lips into a smile, not willing to tell Luo Zheng.
"Today's matter can be considered settled, but we have angered those daoists. I don't fear them, but I reckon that they will target you!" Su Lingyun said to Luo Zheng.
Luo Zheng nodded. "I understand clearly that even if it wasn't because of this matter, they still wouldn't let me go. Moreover! I similarly won't let them go, especially Zhenren Tianqiong and Daoist Still Water! "
Su Lingyun sighed. She had forgotten about this brat's personality.
Simply harming this brat wouldn't incur such great hatred from him. However, if anyone dared to touch his loved ones, he would definitely make them pay ten times the price!
However … from this point of view, it also showed that Luo Zheng was a person who was true to his emotions.
"Alright, let's talk about these things later. With your current strength, not to mention those daoists, you won't be able to deal with a random Divine Realm expert. If you want to save your sister, you still need to increase your strength!" Su Lingyun said with a smile.
Luo Zheng nodded and followed Su Lingyun out of the Admonition Hall.
After the Monster Slaying Trial, as well as the trip to the Immortal Mansion, Luo Zheng's strength had indeed increased by quite a bit. Moreover, he had stepped into the ranks of Xiantian lifeforms.
Outside the imperial capital, a Xiantian lifeform could almost dominate a region, enough to support a small family.
However, in the Burning Heaven Imperial Capital, in the Blue Cloud Sect, they were far from enough.
After returning this time, Luo Zheng also decided to set a goal for himself, to devote himself to training hard.
When Luo Zheng once again stepped into Xiao Yufeng's outer sect, he caused another sensation.
News of Luo Zheng's various astonishing feats in the Monster Slaying Trial had already spread among the outer sect disciples.
Before Luo Zheng joined Xiao Yufeng's outer sect, the strongest person in Xiao Yufeng's outer sect was Hao Shige.
However, in this Monster Slaying Trial, Hao Shige was nothing in front of Luo Zheng!
"Luo Zheng killed a Monster General!"
"Even Tianyi Peak's Zhu Tianlai was only evenly matched with a Monster General. He was actually able to directly kill a Monster General! If it wasn't for him, the entire Tianyi Peak might have been wiped out! "
"He didn't just kill a Monster General. According to the news from Jade Maiden Peak, Luo Zheng faced several Monster Generals alone and killed them all!"
These outer sect disciples had also felt the demonic aura of the Monster Race. Even if they faced a Monster Soldier, they would find it hard to resist that demonic aura.
However, Luo Zheng was actually able to deal with a Monster General. Without a doubt, Luo Zheng had indeed become the idol in the hearts of the outer sect disciples!
This was because Luo Zheng's strength not only surpassed the outer sect, but also surpassed Hao Shige. Many outer sect disciples believed that even in Xiao Yufeng's inner sect, there was probably no one who was a match for Luo Zheng.
"Ah! Boss! This time you're awesome! "When Mo Can, Zhou Xian, and the others saw Luo Zheng, they all rushed forward and gave Luo Zheng a big hug.
Then, the two of them dodged to the side and were met with a big bear hug from Zhang Wuxian!

Blue Cloud Sect, Dinghu Mountain.

Luo Yan was Luo Zheng's reverse scale. Chapter 177
Luo Zheng sat cross-legged in his room, staring intently at the Sun, Moon, and Stars Chart opposite him.

The Blue Cloud Sect's points and various rewards were very reasonable.
If he wanted to enter the cultivation mystic realm to cultivate and quickly improve his strength, he had to help the Blue Cloud Sect complete various missions. The points he obtained from the missions had to be invested in cultivation …
Luo Zheng had wanted to quickly earn a million points, but now it seemed that this idea was a little naive. The points he had were not only for income, but also for expenditure. If he cultivated at this speed, it would be almost impossible for him to accumulate a million points.

Luo Zheng still had about 20,000 square crystals. If he exchanged them for points, he could exchange them for about 10,000 Blue Cloud Sect points.
10,000 points seemed like a lot, but if he used them all to cultivate in the Illusion Fish Deep Pool, it wouldn't be much.
As Luo Zheng dived deeper into the pool day by day, the time he spent was also increasing.
Two hours would cost him 200 points. Four hours would cost him 400 points. If Luo Zheng maintained four hours of cultivation every day, he would use up 400 points a day.
Ten thousand points wouldn't even last a month.

The Heaven's Divination Essence was a treasure that could only be found by chance, especially to those blacksmiths.

Some of the depressions would gradually worsen as people used them too much!
Although on the surface, the mountain wall was indeed smooth and flat, in fact, there were still many depressions.
There were even some disciples who, after climbing hundreds or even thousands of times, had already memorized each and every dent deeply in their minds. After the jump, where the first step should be and where the second step should be had to be taken care of!
Therefore, experience was very important when climbing this mountain wall. Luo Zheng didn't have any experience. If he climbed with his own strength, he would definitely be at a disadvantage.
Wu Da was able to climb to a height of 47 meters because he made good use of these depressions. Secondly, he was very agile! Since ancient times, the number of people who climbed to the top was far less than the number of people who climbed below. Therefore, the higher one went, the fewer depressions there were. The less obvious they were, the more difficult it was.
Although Luo Zheng lacked experience and couldn't find the depressions on the mountain wall, he had an advantage, and that was speed!
The energy of the Phoenix Soaring Crystal played a huge role at this moment. His hands were constantly slapping the mountain wall, and at the same time, his feet were stepping at an extremely fast speed.
In fact, with Luo Zheng's current strength, he could even kick into this hard mountain wall and then jump up. However, doing so would inevitably lead to suspicion of cheating, so he gave up on this idea.
Luo Zheng's control of his own strength had already reached an extremely fine level. Under the constant slapping and stepping, Luo Zheng's speed actually increased again!
"Ah, Luo Zheng's speed actually increased again. Heavens!" An outer court disciple screamed.
"No way? What's going on? This doesn't make sense! "Some outer court disciples' faces were full of confusion. They couldn't figure it out.
Climbing this mountain wall was a linear process of decreasing one's speed.
At the bottom of the mountain, one's strength and speed would be the highest. Because there was no point in the middle of the mountain wall, one's speed would gradually decrease, and the speed of climbing would become slower and slower.
No matter who it was, no one could break this process.
However, when Luo Zheng was halfway up, his speed suddenly increased …
What did this mean? This meant that Luo Zheng didn't need to rely on accumulating strength at the bottom! He could even skip the sprinting part … He could keep climbing up the mountain wall, be it ten meters, thirty meters, a hundred meters, or a thousand meters. To him, climbing up the mountain wall was like running on flat ground. There was no difference.
Under such circumstances, the test of climbing the mountain wall had lost its meaning for Luo Zheng.
Luo Zheng crossed 30 meters, 40 meters, 50 meters, 55 meters at an extremely fast speed … Soon, he surpassed the previous handprint.
This time, Luo Zheng stopped at a height of 60 meters. At the same time, he stretched out his hand and slapped the mountain wall heavily.
"Bang!"

The steel used to refine the Nine Layered Edge was called Thousand Refined Steel. It was an extremely malleable type of steel. First, it was calcined until it was extremely soft. Then, it was placed on a metal plate prepared in advance. The bottom of the plate was stuffed with charcoal.
Once the charcoal was ignited, it would burn for three months until the top layer of the plate was completely red. At the same time, it maintained an extremely neat surface.
Then, the Thousand Refined Steel would be placed on the plate. Then, twelve burly men would push a ten-thousand-kilogram roller to grind the Thousand Refined Steel.
After seven days of grinding, the Thousand Refined Steel would become a thin layer of steel sheet that would firmly adhere to the iron plate. At this time, the iron plate would be removed along with the Thousand Refined Steel sheet. When the temperature naturally dropped, the Thousand Refined Steel sheet would automatically fall off the iron plate.
This extremely thin steel sheet was the raw material used to make the Ninefold Blade.
Che Daozi would personally fold the steel sheet, layer by layer. During this process, he would fold it nine times. During each fold, he would add in all sorts of special materials and a secret forging method that Che Daozi wouldn't pass on to outsiders.
The entire process was extremely complicated.
Once the steel sheet was folded together, it would be sent into a crafting furnace to be refined with true fire. The refiner's comprehension of the Heaven's Divination Essence would be slowly refined into it.
In truth, the Nine Layered Edge's forging method was already known to the public.
But apart from Che Daozi himself, no one else could do this!

The woman shook her head. "Che Daozi used the last part of his life to forge this sword. Che Daozi and my father were good friends. In his will, Che Daozi left instructions that if a weapon refiner could refine it into an immortal weapon in the future, he would give it to them for free. However, if he wasn't confident, he wouldn't sell it no matter how high the price was …"
Luo Zheng's lips curled up. "If I was confident in refining this sword into an immortal weapon, would you really give it to me?"
The middle-aged shopkeeper was startled by Luo Zheng's words. However, his boss was here and it wasn't his turn to speak.
The woman covered her mouth with her hand and laughed. "Young master, you must be joking. You're not even a weapon refiner and don't even have true fire in your body. How would you know how to refine?"
In fact, refining didn't require true fire, but those who knew how to refine were naturally weapon refiners. The woman saw that Luo Zheng cultivated true essence and didn't use true fire. Naturally, she doubted Luo Zheng's words. If one wanted to refine that sword into an immortal weapon, they had to be a weapon refiner first!
"You're wrong. I don't cultivate true fire cultivation methods, but does refining really require true fire in my body? Can't other unusual fires also be used to refine weapons? "Luo Zheng laughed.
The woman sighed. She was sure that Luo Zheng was fooling her. After all, she could tell at a glance whether he was a weapon refiner or not. No matter what, the young man in front of her couldn't be a weapon refiner. It was too easy to expose his lies. "Since you're a weapon refiner, show me your so-called unusual fire!"
After saying that, the woman flicked her finger, and the flames in the fireplace began to shrink. In the end, it shrank to the size of a palm, and the shape of the flame turned into the shape of a bird. It flew out of the fireplace.

. The fire spirit was a very special kind of flame.
It was said that in ancient times, there was a clan that built a furnace. The furnace never went out. This clan was very powerful. In a thousand years, they gradually expanded their territory and became the largest clan in the ancient Eastern Domain. The original furnace had become the sacred fire of this clan. In the past thousand years, the sacred fire in the furnace never went out!
That flame burned for thousands of years. Finally, a fire spirit was born!
Burning for thousands of years could give birth to a fire spirit, and it was only a possibility!
It could be imagined that the fire spirit was extremely rare. Luo Zheng had absorbed the Earth Core Fire. He didn't know how long the Earth Core Fire had existed in the underground cave, but he had never encountered a fire spirit.
"I don't like others wasting my time. I hope you're not a liar," the woman said in a hoarse voice.
The little fire spirit circled around the woman's finger. It danced. From time to time, it stared at Luo Zheng with its green bean-sized fire eyes. It suddenly let out a cry, as if it felt the will of its master and threatened Luo Zheng.
Who was the owner of the Thousand Secrets Pavilion?
Since when was there such an expert hiding in the Burning Heaven Empire? Looking at the woman's age, she seemed to be in her early twenties. However, her strength was unfathomable. Luo Zheng couldn't see how strong she was.
Even the Blue Cloud Sect wouldn't be able to cultivate such a talent!
However, Luo Zheng was very calm when the other party asked him to demonstrate the flame. Instead, he said, "You mean, if I have a strange flame, you can give this sword to me for free?"
The woman smiled faintly and said, "Of course it's impossible. It depends on whether or not you're qualified. Che Daozi is an old senior, so I naturally have to help him fulfill his final wish. If you only use ordinary flames, you won't be qualified. How can I give this sword to you? If you leave the Thousand Secrets Pavilion and casually find a blacksmith to refine the sword into a high-grade or even mid-grade spirit weapon, then you'll be going against Che Daozi's wishes. "
Luo Zheng smiled and said to Shopkeeper Qi, "Can you leave for a moment?"
Shopkeeper Qi glanced at Luo Zheng and silently left the room. For Shopkeeper Qi, business was far more important than curiosity. This was the truth he had learned after so many years in the business world.
After Shopkeeper Qi left and closed the door, Luo Zheng communicated with the giant furnace in his mind.
Then, a pure black flame drilled out from between his eyebrows and floated in front of Luo Zheng.
Ordinary flames would generate heat. Even the fire spirit in the furnace couldn't completely restrain all the heat. It was only because the woman wasn't afraid of high temperatures that the firebird could dance around her hand. If it was an ordinary person, they would've been burned to a crisp by the fire spirit.
However, the black flame that Luo Zheng summoned seemed to have no temperature at all.
The moment the wisp of black fire was summoned, the Fire Spirit beside the woman's hand seemed to have met its nemesis. Suddenly, it began to tremble violently. On its bird-like body, traces of flames were constantly trembling!
The woman's pupils suddenly shrank. She looked cautiously at the black flame in Luo Zheng's hand, unable to hide the shock on her face!
The fire spirit in the woman's hand seemed to be unable to resist the fear of the black flame. While trembling, it suddenly circled in the air and then drilled into the furnace next to it.
"Your flame …" The woman said cautiously, "Is it a fire spirit?"
Luo Zheng let the black flame circle in the air for a while before calling it back. The black flame wasn't completely under Luo Zheng's control. It originally intended to come out to find food.
The black flame had a wide range of food. In addition to devouring divine weapons, other flames could also become its food.
Originally, when it found a fire spirit in its eyes, it became excited and wanted to rush over. However, it didn't expect Luo Zheng to order it to return to the furnace in his mind. Naturally, it was reluctant.
However, it lived in Luo Zheng's mind after all. Moreover, Luo Zheng had fed it a lot of weapons before. Therefore, after it circled in the air, it drilled into Luo Zheng's forehead again.
Luo Zheng smiled slightly and said, "I don't know if it's a fire spirit or not, but I hope you will fulfill your promise!"
The woman obviously hadn't woken up from the shock of the black flame.
With her knowledge and experience, she had seen no less than a hundred types of Deviant Flames and Fire Spirits. With her knowledge, the power of a flame was not measured by the amount of heat it released or its destructive power, but by the degree to which the flame was restrained!
For example, the fire spirit beside her. If the power of the flame was restrained to the limit, it could fly close to the wood without igniting it.
This was an extremely powerful fire spirit.
However, when she saw Luo Zheng's black flame, it didn't seem to have any temperature. It was as if it was an icy existence. It was as if other than the shape of a flame, it wasn't actually a flame!
Just how powerful was this flame?
Luo Zheng didn't know the answer to this question, so the woman naturally didn't know either.
After all, until now, Luo Zheng hadn't found anything that the black flame couldn't destroy. Even if it was a high-grade profound weapon made of the hardest material, it would be instantly decomposed into Heaven's Essence under the burning of the black flame. In front of the black flame, everything was as soft as a candle.
The woman looked deeply at Luo Zheng with a trace of hesitation in her eyes. "Although you have an Mystical Flame, you are not a weapon refiner!"
"I am indeed not a weapon refiner, but I can become one. I am very confident that I can refine that sword into an immortal weapon," Luo Zheng said with a faint smile.
It was true that Luo Zheng hadn't mastered the technique of weapon refinement, but the problem was that he had an extraordinary amount of Heaven's Essence. He didn't believe that with so much Heaven's Essence, he couldn't refine that sword.
A person who wasn't a weapon refiner dared to say that he could refine an immortal weapon. If she hadn't seen Luo Zheng's strange flame, the woman wouldn't have believed it even if she was beaten to death. But now, she was a little shaken. This young man was obviously not an ordinary person. What other secrets did he have?
When did such a talent appear in the Eastern Region?
Thinking of her master's words and her father's instructions, she suddenly smiled and said to Luo Zheng, "Since I said it before, I will do it!" With that, she clapped her hands. The middle-aged shopkeeper who was standing outside the door pushed open the door and came in. "Shopkeeper Qi, give that sword to him!"
Shopkeeper Qi's face showed hesitation. "This …"
The woman waved her hand. "I will give you the reward you deserve. Don't worry."
Upon hearing the woman's words, Shopkeeper Qi handed the sword in his hand to Luo Zheng.
Luo Zheng took the sword and bowed to the woman with cupped hands. "Thank you for the sword!"
The woman nodded and said carelessly, "Although giving this sword to you isn't the best choice, there hasn't been a new weapon refiner in the Eastern Region for so many years. Wang Dai and another grandmaster aren't willing to make a move, so it's a waste to leave this sword here. If you are really confident, you can give it a try. Just like Che Daozi said in his last words, everything depends on the fated one!"
Luo Zheng nodded and thanked him again before leaving. He was overjoyed and could not wait to see how far he could condense the sword with the Heaven's Derivation Essence …
After Luo Zheng left, Shopkeeper Qi's expression suddenly changed. He looked at the woman with shining eyes and said, "You seem to have gone a bit overboard with your actions!"
The woman shook her head. Her eyes lazily looked at the raging flames in the fireplace. That Fire Spirit was still squatting in the fireplace, shivering. She said indifferently, "Rules? How many geniuses have appeared in the Eastern Region during these years? The only one left is still trapped in Purgatory Mountain. If they are allowed to continue messing around, I fear that this entire eastern region will be completely ruined! "
"But this brat is merely …" Shopkeeper Qi shook his head, still not agreeing with her words.
"Merely what? An Xiantian lifeform? My vision has never been wrong. I'm afraid that the Blue Cloud Sect alone won't be able to accommodate him. Just wait and see. It won't be long before he really has the qualifications to walk on the Blue Cloud Road! "The woman narrowed her eyes as she spoke. Her eyes were like those of a cat, exuding endless charm.
"You are this sure?" Shopkeeper Qi asked with a serious expression.
The woman suddenly turned around and pointed at the fireplace. She said to Shopkeeper Qi with a smile, "You weren't in the room just now, so I don't blame you for not knowing the situation. Look at the Vermilion Bird in the fireplace, it's so scared!"
Shopkeeper Qi looked over. The Vermilion Bird in the fireplace was currently shaking violently, as if it was greatly frightened …
Shopkeeper Qi's expression immediately changed. "This, why is the Vermilion Bird so scared?!"

Chapter 200
Luo Zheng didn't have to spend a single square crystal to get an unfinished weapon for free. He could be considered extremely lucky.
However, Luo Zheng also understood clearly that the other party didn't give it away for free.
Last time, when Luo Zheng purchased weapons, he didn't see through it. However, this time, Luo Zheng understood. Regardless of whether it was Shopkeeper Qi or that woman, they were definitely not ordinary people!
That Shopkeeper Qi could be ignored, but that woman's strength was profound to the point where Luo Zheng couldn't see through her at all. Just how powerful was she? Moreover, she even had a Fire Spirit at her side.
A small Thousand Secrets Pavilion that sold weapons actually hid this type of person. Burning Sky Empire really was full of hidden dragons and crouching tigers.
Only, why would they hide in Thousand Secrets Pavilion? This was something Luo Zheng couldn't figure out.
However, since he noticed them, then Luo Zheng decided that it would be best if he was a bit more careful.
When he returned to Blue Cloud Sect, it was still early in the morning. Today, the mountains were covered in mists. The various peaks within Blue Cloud Sect were covered in clouds and mist.
Luo Zheng entered the sect, but didn't go to Xiao Yufeng.
Instead, he walked towards Dipping Fire Peak at the back of the sect.
Dipping Fire Peak didn't belong to the thirty-three peaks, but rather to the side adjacent to Purgatory Peak.
Purgatory Mountain was the only active volcano within Blue Cloud Sect. However, there was a fire vein that extended from Purgatory Mountain on Dipping Fire Peak. Meanwhile, Blue Cloud Sect precisely listed this place as the Blue Cloud Sect's Weapon Refining Sect.
Even though this peak also recruited disciples, the disciples they recruited didn't practice martial arts, but rather weapon refining.
Compared to the other peaks' disciple examinations, what this peak tested wasn't the martial dao, but rather the dao of weapon refining.
However, Blue Cloud Sect wasn't particularly outstanding in cultivating weapon refiners. That was why the number of disciples on Dipping Fire Peak wasn't that many. It wasn't like the thirty-three peaks that were packed with people. On any one of the peaks, the number of outer disciples exceeded ten thousand.
All of the disciples on this Dipping Fire Peak added up to only a thousand people.
Even though the number was small, Dipping Fire Peak's disciples were still rather popular.
There weren't many craftsmen in the entire Eastern Region. Although Dipping Fire Peak hadn't produced any craftsmen at the grandmaster level, many of the disciples were quite skilled.
There were so many disciples in the Blue Cloud Sect. At the beginning, they cultivated fist techniques. When they reached the middle stage, they would definitely need to choose a weapon that belonged to them. However, the price of weapons was so expensive now. A random high-grade mystic artifact would cost more than a hundred cubes of crystal stones. It was far from what an ordinary disciple could afford.
Therefore, many of the Blue Cloud Sect's disciples chose to entrust Dipping Fire Peak's disciples to forge weapons.
In order to support the blacksmiths in Dipping Fire Peak, the Blue Cloud Sect also issued a rule that anyone who helped a Blue Cloud Sect disciple forge a weapon would be rewarded with a certain amount of points. This rule undoubtedly stimulated the enthusiasm of the blacksmiths in Dipping Fire Peak.
Blacksmiths were extremely wealthy, but at the same time, they were also extremely poor. It was because during the process of refining weapons, they needed to consume large amounts of materials, but what they produced was a pile of waste. Meanwhile, the value of those materials used for refining weapons was often not cheap. Once the refinement failed, the materials would all be lost, the amount that could be recycled was extremely small.
This type of waste wasn't something normal people could afford. That was why those who wished to become a blacksmith, first of all, didn't have to look at their talent in the path of refining, but rather whether their family was wealthy or not!
Dipping Fire Peak wasn't far from Purgatory Mountain, and this peak wasn't that tall either. When one stood at the foot of Dipping Fire Peak, they could see the towering Purgatory Mountain to the side. When the two were compared, Dipping Fire Peak would only seem like a small hill.
Right now, there were expanses of black smoke continuously rising from that hill. This should be the result of Dipping Fire Peak's disciples refining weapons. During the refining process, if one didn't control the flame well, the refining furnace would produce roiling black smoke.
If one's true flame was controlled well, then when the refining furnace was completely burned, there wouldn't be any smoke.
As he walked up Dipping Fire Peak's low and gentle mountain path, he soon saw the neatly arranged buildings at the top. What left Luo Zheng sighed with admiration was that these buildings were all unique. Most of them were made from steel mixed with stone. He didn't see a single building made from wood at the top of Dipping Fire Peak.
It was likely that there was a volcanic vein below Dipping Fire Peak, so the temperature was extremely high year-round. Moreover, during the refining process, it was hard to avoid producing sparks. Wood was too easily ignited, which was why there weren't any wooden buildings here.
Luo Zheng's goal was only to borrow a refining furnace. A refining furnace wasn't hard to find on Dipping Fire Peak. He only needed to look towards the sky, follow the roiling black smoke, and then find it.
Stepping over a lintel, he entered a courtyard. In the courtyard, there was a copper furnace that was about the height of a person. This copper furnace was the refining furnace.
Back in Xie Lang's cave, Luo Zheng was locked in the refining furnace and refined for a long time. At that time, Luo Zheng originally wanted to take Xie Lang's refining furnace, but it was too big and couldn't be stored in the Sumeru Ring, so he could only give up.
Xie Lang was only a Half-step Innate Realm refiner. Although he had some unique attainments in refining weapons, he naturally couldn't be compared to the Blue Cloud Sect. The copper furnace in front of him was shiny, and there were all kinds of runes engraved on the furnace wall. Obviously, it was much more advanced than Xie Lang's refining furnace.
Around the refining furnace, there were seven or eight disciples bustling about.
The refiners on Dipping Fire Peak were obviously divided into inner and outer sect. However, the inner and outer sect disciples on the thirty-three peaks, such as Xiao Yufeng, were basically separated from each other. On the other hand, the inner and outer sect disciples on Dipping Fire Peak were all together, dividing the work.
The outer sect disciples were mainly responsible for some rough work, such as hard labor, carrying, doing odd jobs and so on. The inner sect disciples were responsible for spitting True Fire into the copper furnace.
When Luo Zheng entered, a black-robed disciple was sitting cross-legged at the head of the courtyard. From his hands, True Fire was constantly flowing into the opening above the copper furnace.
A few white-robed disciples, who were in charge of odd jobs, saw Luo Zheng enter. One of them came up and said, "Our Seventeenth Courtyard is refining weapons! Strangers are not allowed to come near! "
The disciples on Dipping Fire Peak were divided according to their courtyard. Along the way, the front of each house was marked with a courtyard number, and this house was marked with "Seventeenth Courtyard".
Today, the disciples of the Seventeenth Courtyard were refining a high-grade Xuan Weapon.
The difficulty of refining a middle-grade Xuan Weapon was still a little difficult for these disciples. Although the True Fire in their bodies was purer and more powerful than Xie Lang's, in terms of technique and proficiency, it was far from Xie Lang's.
Seeing the aggressive looks of the outer sect disciples, Luo Zheng stopped in his tracks.
One of the outer sect disciples came forward and sized up Luo Zheng. He found that Luo Zheng was Xiao Yufeng's disciple.
Generally, the disciples of the 33 peaks who came to Dipping Fire Peak were commissioned to refine weapons. For the disciples of Dipping Fire Peak, this was a good thing.
However, Luo Zheng was wearing a white robe. Generally speaking, he belonged to the grassroots with no money and no power. He shouldn't have much money on hand, let alone points. The number of tasks that the outer sect disciples could complete could be counted on one's fingers. Their points were pitifully small. They probably couldn't even afford the cheapest low-grade Xuan Weapon.
Therefore, the outer sect disciple didn't have a good expression. He vaguely asked, "What are you doing here? Do you want to buy weapons? "
Luo Zheng shook his head and said, "I'm not buying."
The Xuan Weapons refined by the disciples of Dipping Fire Peak certainly couldn't enter Luo Zheng's eyes.
"Then why did you come to Dipping Fire Peak? Where are you going to have fun? Can you afford to disturb our senior brother refining a high-grade Xuan Weapon? " The outer sect disciple waved his hand to drive Luo Zheng away. When talking about high-grade Xuan Weapons, he was quite proud. Dipping Fire Peak had more than a thousand disciples and was divided into hundreds of small courtyards. The number of small courtyards that could refine high-grade Xuan Weapons could be counted on one's fingers. If they succeeded today, it would be a great merit. The disciples of the 17 courtyards, regardless of whether they were outer or inner sect disciples, would receive a lot of rewards.
Of course, this might be a lot for them, but in Luo Zheng's eyes, it was naturally a small amount.
Although the outer sect disciple was driving Luo Zheng away, Luo Zheng didn't move. Instead, he stood in place and shook his head and said, "I want to borrow your crafting furnace."
When the outer sect disciple heard Luo Zheng's words, he suddenly laughed and said, "Don't tell me you're here to make fun of me? You want to borrow our crafting furnace? You want to refine weapons? "
"I don't want to refine weapons. I just want to condense," Luo Zheng said seriously.
Refining weapons was a complicated technique. Luo Zheng didn't have a systematic training, so he was very unfamiliar with the first few steps of refining weapons. However, the condensing step only tested the refiner's understanding of the Way of Heaven's Divination. Luo Zheng might not have a deep understanding of the Way of Heaven's Divination, but he had the essence of Heaven's Divination in his hands. Therefore, it shouldn't be difficult for Luo Zheng to condense weapons.
"Haha …" The outer sect disciple seemed to have heard a big joke. As the saying goes, different professions make one feel different. The disciples of the 33 peaks were all martial artists, not refiners. Of course, it didn't mean that there wasn't a single refiner among the hundreds of thousands of disciples in the 33 peaks. The world was so big that there was never a lack of geniuses. Some of them were both martial artists and proficient in refining weapons. However, the outer sect disciple stubbornly believed that Luo Zheng couldn't do it.
"I've said that if you have nothing to do but make fun of me, you can go wherever you want. Hurry up and leave. I'm going to close the door!" The outer sect disciple finally couldn't bear it and wanted to drive Luo Zheng away.
